descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Infrastructure Support and Workstation Specialist (80-100%)

As a member of the Infrastructure Support team, you will be responsible for providing advanced Level 2 support and ensuring a high-quality IT experience for end users. Acting as the main escalation point for incidents raised by the Service Desk, you will work closely with various IT teams to deliver efficient and sustainable solutions.

YOUR ROLE

• Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve infrastructure and workplace-related incidents escalated by the Service Desk.

• Provide support for workstations, telephony, messaging, mobility solutions, collaboration tools, and printing services.

• Investigate technical issues directly with end users and ensure timely resolution.

• Collaborate closely with the Service Desk and Level 3 support teams to facilitate incident resolution and proper escalation when required.

• Coordinate with internal IT teams including Security, Systems, Networks, and Packaging.

• Monitor workstation health and performance using tools such as Nexthink, Splunk, Event Viewer, and other monitoring platforms.

• Identify recurring issues, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to service improvements.

• Create, maintain, and enhance troubleshooting procedures, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to optimize workplace services and support processes.

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or equivalent professional experience.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in a Level 2 IT Support, Workplace Support, or Infrastructure Support role.

• Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11, Microsoft Office 365, Active Directory, Exchange, and Citrix environments.

• Experience supporting mobility and collaboration solutions such as Microsoft Teams, AirWatch/MDM, Kurmi, and Cisco Jabber.

• Good understanding of scripting and automation tools, particularly PowerShell and VBScript.

• Familiarity with monitoring and troubleshooting tools such as Splunk and Nexthink.

• Knowledge of software deployment and application packaging concepts, including SCCM and App-V, is an asset.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured troubleshooting approach.

• Proactive, autonomous, well-organized, and able to manage priorities effectively.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a strong customer-service mindset.

• Ability to perform under pressure while maintaining a high level of service quality.

• Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients
descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati ed istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari meglio capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti.

Con una storia che dura oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie.

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti.

Infrastrutture di supporto e Workstation Specialist (80-100%)

Come membro del team Infrastructure Support, sarete responsabili di fornire un supporto avanzato di Livello 2 e garantire un'esperienza IT di alta qualità per gli utenti finali. Essendo il principale punto di escalation per gli incidenti sollevati dal Service Desk, lavorerai a stretto contatto con vari team IT per fornire soluzioni efficienti e sostenibili.

Il tuo!

• Analizzare, risolvere i problemi e risolvere gli incidenti legati all'infrastruttura e al luogo di lavoro escalati dal Service Desk.

• Fornire supporto per workstation, telefonia, messaggistica, soluzioni di mobilità, strumenti di collaborazione e servizi di stampa.

• Indagare le questioni tecniche direttamente con gli utenti finali e garantire una risoluzione tempestiva.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di supporto Service Desk e Level 3 per facilitare la risoluzione degli incidenti e la corretta escalation quando necessario.

• Coordinare con i team IT interni tra cui sicurezza, sistemi, reti e imballaggio.

• Monitorare la salute e le prestazioni delle workstation utilizzando strumenti come Nexthink, Splunk, Event Viewer e altre piattaforme di monitoraggio.

• Identificare i problemi ricorrenti, eseguire analisi causa radice e contribuire a migliorare il servizio.

• Creare, mantenere e migliorare le procedure di risoluzione dei problemi, la documentazione tecnica e gli articoli di base della conoscenza.

• Partecipa a iniziative di miglioramento continuo per ottimizzare i servizi di lavoro e i processi di supporto.

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea in Informatica o equivalente esperienza professionale.

• Minimo 2 anni di esperienza in un supporto IT di livello 2, supporto sul posto di lavoro, o ruolo di supporto alle infrastrutture.

• Forte conoscenza di Windows 10/11, Microsoft Office 365, Active Directory, Exchange e ambienti Citrix.

• Scopri soluzioni di mobilità e collaborazione come Microsoft Teams, AirWatch/MDM, Kurmi e Cisco Jabber.

• Buona comprensione degli strumenti di scrittura e automazione, in particolare PowerShell e VBScript.

• Familiarità con strumenti di monitoraggio e risoluzione dei problemi come Splunk e Nexthink.

• La conoscenza dei concetti di distribuzione del software e di imballaggio delle applicazioni, tra cui SCCM e App-V, è un bene.

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con un approccio strutturato di risoluzione dei problemi.

• Proattivo, autonomo, ben organizzato e in grado di gestire efficacemente le priorità.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione con una forte mentalità di servizio al cliente.

• Capacità di eseguire sotto pressione mantenendo un alto livello di qualità del servizio.

• Fluente in francese e inglese, sia scritto che parlato.

NB: Si prega di essere consapevoli del fatto che, in conformità con le normative vigenti e i requisiti di lavoro, il candidato selezionato sarà richiesto di fornire un record penale (sezione 3).

Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo una squadra unica, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti
descriptionByLocale.de:

Als innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden ist unsere unabhängige Kanzlei eine der am besten kapitalisierten Bankengruppen der Welt, die fast CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten aus operiert.

Mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ist Lombard Odier ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskretionärem und beratendem Portfoliomanagement, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Verwahrung bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienstleistungen und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Managers und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie für andere Finanzinstitute.

„Rethink Everything ist unsere Philosophie – sie steht im Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker geworden, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu überdenken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten.

Infrastruktur-Support und Workstation-Spezialist (80-100%)

Als Mitglied des Infrastruktur-Support-Teams sind Sie für die Bereitstellung eines erweiterten Level 2-Supports und die Gewährleistung einer hochwertigen IT-Erfahrung für Endbenutzer verantwortlich. Als wichtigster Eskalationspunkt für Vorfälle, die vom Service Desk ausgelöst werden, arbeiten Sie eng mit verschiedenen IT-Teams zusammen, um effiziente und nachhaltige Lösungen zu liefern.

IHRE ROLLE

• Analysieren, Beheben und Beheben von Infrastruktur- und Arbeitsplatzvorfällen, die vom Service Desk eskaliert wurden.

• Unterstützung für Workstations, Telefonie, Messaging, Mobilitätslösungen, Collaboration-Tools und Druckdienste.

• Untersuchen Sie technische Probleme direkt mit den Endnutzern und sorgen Sie für eine rechtzeitige Lösung.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Service Desk und den Supportteams von Level 3 zusammen, um bei Bedarf die Lösung von Vorfällen und eine angemessene Eskalation zu ermöglichen.

• Koordinieren Sie sich mit internen IT-Teams wie Security, Systems, Networks und Packaging.

• Überwachen Sie den Zustand und die Leistung der Workstation mit Tools wie Nexthink, Splunk, Event Viewer und anderen Überwachungsplattformen.

• Identifizieren Sie wiederkehrende Probleme, führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse durch und tragen Sie zu Serviceverbesserungen bei.

• Erstellen, pflegen und verbessern Sie Fehlerbehebungsverfahren, technische Dokumentation und Artikel zur Wissensdatenbank.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Optimierung von Arbeitsplatzdienstleistungen und Unterstützungsprozessen.

IHR PROFIL

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informationstechnologie oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung.

• Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in einem Level 2 IT Support, Workplace Support oder Infrastructure Support Rolle.

• Gute Kenntnisse in Windows 10/11, Microsoft Office 365, Active Directory, Exchange und Citrix-Umgebungen.

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Mobilitäts- und Kollaborationslösungen wie Microsoft Teams, AirWatch/MDM, Kurmi und Cisco Jabber.

• Gutes Verständnis von Skript- und Automatisierungstools, insbesondere PowerShell und VBScript.

• Vertrautheit mit Überwachungs- und Fehlerbehebungstools wie Splunk und Nexthink.

• Das Wissen über Software-Bereitstellungs- und Anwendungsverpackungskonzepte, einschließlich SCCM und App-V, ist eine Bereicherung.

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit einem strukturierten Problembehandlungsansatz.

• Proaktiv, autonom, gut organisiert und in der Lage, Prioritäten effektiv zu verwalten.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit einer starken Kundenservice-Mentalität.

• Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig eine hohe Servicequalität aufrechtzuerhalten.

• Fließend Französisch und Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen.

NB: Bitte beachten Sie, dass gemäß den geltenden Gesetzen und Stellenanforderungen der ausgewählte Kandidat aufgefordert wird, ein Strafregister vorzulegen (Abschnitt 3).

Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns an, die Besten bei dem zu sein, was wir tun, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt antreibt. Respekt untermauert jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unser Handeln. Zusammen sind wir ein Team, vereint im Dienst unserer Kunden
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de 300 milliards de francs et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux répartis sur 4 continents.

Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières.

Repenser Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients.

Spécialiste du soutien à l'infrastructure et des postes de travail (80-100%)

En tant que membre de l'équipe de soutien de l'infrastructure, vous serez responsable de fournir un soutien avancé de niveau 2 et d'assurer une expérience informatique de haute qualité pour les utilisateurs finaux. En tant que principal point d'escalade pour les incidents soulevés par le Service Desk, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec diverses équipes informatiques pour offrir des solutions efficaces et durables.

Votre rôle

• Analyser, dépanner et résoudre les incidents liés à l'infrastructure et au lieu de travail qui se sont intensifiés par le Service Desk.

• Fournir un soutien pour les postes de travail, la téléphonie, la messagerie, les solutions de mobilité, les outils de collaboration et les services d'impression.

• Enquêter directement sur les problèmes techniques avec les utilisateurs finaux et veiller à leur résolution en temps opportun.

• Collaborer étroitement avec le Service Desk et les équipes de soutien de niveau 3 pour faciliter la résolution des incidents et l'escalade appropriée au besoin.

• Coordonner avec les équipes informatiques internes, y compris la sécurité, les systèmes, les réseaux et l'emballage.

• Surveillez la santé et les performances des postes de travail à l'aide d'outils tels que Nexthink, Spunk, Event Viewer et d'autres plateformes de surveillance.

• Identifier les problèmes récurrents, analyser les causes profondes et contribuer à l'amélioration des services.

• Créer, maintenir et améliorer les procédures de dépannage, la documentation technique et les articles de base de connaissances.

• Participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour optimiser les services en milieu de travail et les processus de soutien.

VOTRE PROFIL

• Baccalauréat en technologie de l'information ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

• Au moins deux ans d'expérience dans un rôle de soutien de la TI de niveau 2, de soutien en milieu de travail ou de soutien de l'infrastructure.

• Forte connaissance des environnements Windows 10/11, Microsoft Office 365, Active Directory, Exchange et Citrix.

• Découvrez des solutions de mobilité et de collaboration comme Microsoft Teams, AirWatch/MDM, Kurmi et Cisco Jabber.

• Bonne compréhension des outils de script et d'automatisation, en particulier PowerShell et VBScript.

• Familiarité avec les outils de surveillance et de dépannage tels que Splunk et Nexthink.

• La connaissance des concepts de déploiement de logiciels et d'emballage d'applications, y compris SCCM et App-V, est un atout.

• Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec une approche structurée de dépannage.

• Proactive, autonome, bien organisée et capable de gérer efficacement les priorités.

• Excellentes compétences de communication et de collaboration avec un fort état d'esprit service client.

• Capacité à effectuer sous pression tout en maintenant un niveau élevé de qualité de service.

• En français et en anglais, écrits et parlés.

NB: Veuillez noter que, conformément à la loi actuelle et aux exigences du poste, le candidat sélectionné sera invité à fournir un casier judiciaire (article 3).

L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients

• Knowledge of tools such as Splunk, Nexthink, SCCM, or App-V is considered a strong advantage.

This internship is an opportunity to develop valuable technical and professional skills in a real-world enterprise environment.

You will:

• Gain practical experience supporting a large-scale IT infrastructure.

• Work on real incidents and technology challenges from day one.

• Learn from experienced IT professionals and infrastructure experts.

• Develop your troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

• Build knowledge of enterprise tools, processes, and best practices.

• Expand your professional network within an international organization.

• Strengthen your CV with hands-on experience highly valued by employers.

WHY JOIN US

• Work in an international and collaborative environment in Luxembourg.

• Be part of a supportive team that values learning and development.

As a member of our Operations team in Luxembourg, you will discover various Middle Office / Operations activities and learn how much they are central and critical to our Maison, worldwide. You will be an all-rounder and work with our main Operations teams, such as:

• Security Master File: Opening and updating information in the Security Masterfile database on financial instruments held by our clients.

• Income: Payment of dividends, coupons and redemptions on behalf of our clients for all markets and all types of financial instruments, including structured products and derivatives

• Reconciliation: Reconcile cash, securities, listed derivatives, precious metals, etc. Comparing transactions and balances of the Bank’s books with our network of cash counterparties, securities depositories, Transfer Agents etc.

• Operational Taxes: Preparation of tax calculations and statements for Europe- based retail clients and enterprises.

YOUR ROLE

• Assist team members in daily tasks

• Work on specific project and requests, while learning from senior peers

YOUR PROFILE

• A keen interest in the Banking sector, especially in Middle Office / Operations domains

• Collaborative team player with the ability to work independently

• Motivated, detail-oriented, proactive, able to multi-task

• Fluent in French, basic English proficiency

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera in Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato gestore patrimoniale e patrimoniale globale, con una forte attenzione agli investimenti sostenibili. Con una storia che dura da oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione di portafoglio discrezionale e di consulenza, servizi patrimoniali e custodia. Offriamo inoltre servizi di gestione patrimoniale e strategie di investimento tramite Lombard Odier Investment Managers e forniamo tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altri istituti finanziari.

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo diventati più forti attraverso oltre 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo che ci circonda per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento ai nostri clienti.

Amministratore gestione identità e accessi (80-100%)

All'interno del dipartimento IT Operations, entrerai a far parte del team Identity & Access Management (IAM) di Lombard Odier, responsabile della gestione di identità, accesso e sicurezza associata per oltre 3.000 dipendenti.

Nel contesto di una trasformazione verso Zero Trust, RBAC e modelli cloud/ibridi (Entra ID/Azure AD), contribuirai attivamente a proteggere e automatizzare il ciclo di vita dell'identità.

IL TUO RUOLO

Gestione dell'identità e degli accessi:

• Elaborare e analizzare le richieste di accesso tramite strumenti ITSM (ServiceNow)

• Garantire il provisioning/deprovisioning dell'accesso e risolvere gli incidenti IAM

• Gestire identità, account e gruppi in Active Directory e ID Entra (Azure AD)

• Amministrare i diritti di accesso (NTFS, condivisioni di file, applicazioni aziendali)

• Monitorare il processo JML (Jointers/Movers/ Leavers).

Automazione e miglioramento continuo:

• Contribuire all'automazione dei processi IAM (flussi di lavoro, script, API)

• Sostenere il miglioramento dei modelli di accesso (RBAC/ABAC)

• Integrare nuove applicazioni nell'ecosistema IAM (SSO, provisioning, federazione)

• Partecipare alla transizione verso Zero Trust e architetture improntate all'identità

Governance e sicurezza dell'identità:

• Gestire e migliorare i flussi di lavoro di assegnazione degli accessi (IGA)

• Partecipare alle campagne di ricertificazione dell'accesso

• Amministrare l'accesso privilegiato tramite una soluzione PAM (ad esempio, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, ecc.)

• Contribuire alla gestione degli accessi sensibili e dei segreti (Vault)

• Supportare controlli e audit di conformità (FINMA, ISO, ecc.)

Supporto e collaborazione:

• Fornire supporto di livello 2/3 su questioni relative a IAM

• Collaborare con i team di sicurezza, infrastruttura, applicazioni e rischio

• Scrivere e mantenere procedure tecniche e documentazione IAM

IL TUO PROFILO

• Forte esperienza in ambito IAM (Identity & Access Management)

• Ottima conoscenza di Active Directory (on-premise) e Entra ID/Azure AD

• Buona conoscenza dei concetti RBAC/ABAC, SSO (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC), provisioning/SCIM

• Esperienza con uno strumento IAM/IGA (ad esempio, SailPoint, One Identity, Saviynt, ServiceNow IAM)

• Esperienza o esposizione alle soluzioni PAM

• Conoscenza approfondita degli ambienti Windows Server e della sicurezza degli accessi

• La conoscenza di scripting/automazione/GenAI (PowerShell, API, Copilot) è molto apprezzata

• Esperienza in un ambiente bancario o regolamentato

• Conoscenza dei modelli Zero Trust/Identity Security

• Familiarità con ServiceNow e strumenti di monitoraggio (Splunk, Grafana, Elastic, SIEM)

• Esperienza nell'integrazione delle applicazioni (SSO/federazione)

• Comprensione delle sfide legate al cloud e all'identità ibrida

• Attenzione ai dettagli e forte mentalità di sicurezza

• Capacità analitiche e capacità di risolvere problemi complessi

• Giocatore di squadra con eccellenti capacità interpersonali

• Autonomo e proattivo

• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente esigente e in evoluzione

• Sono richiesti francese fluente e inglese professionale

• Responsible, rigorous, versatile, flexible, with good interpersonal skills

• Fluent in English and French

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Launch your HR career in an international environment

Are you looking for more than just an administrative internship?

Join our European Human Resources team and gain hands-on experience across several HR disciplines while working with colleagues from Luxembourg, Paris, Brussels, Madrid and Milan.

As an HR Intern, you will play an active role in supporting employees throughout their journey, contributing to talent initiatives, learning & development programs, benefits management and impactful HR projects. This is a unique opportunity to discover the reality of HR within an international financial institution and build valuable skills alongside experienced HR professionals.

YOUR ROLE

Employee Experience & HR Operations

Help us deliver a seamless employee experience across Europe by:

• Preparing employment-related documents (contracts, amendments, certificates and HR letters)

• Supporting employee onboarding and HR administration processes

• Maintaining and updating employee data

• Assisting with leave and absence management activities

• Ensuring the accuracy and quality of HR records

Learning & Development

Contribute to the growth and development of our employees by:

• Coordinating training sessions and learning activities

• Managing registrations, attendance tracking and learning systems

• Organizing training logistics and communications

• Supporting projects that promote continuous learning across Europe

Compensation & Benefits

Discover how employee benefits are managed within an international organization:

• Supporting the management of the European company car fleet

• Coordinating benefit programs such as meal vouchers and health insurance

• Interacting with external providers and internal stakeholders

Young Talent Programs

Take ownership of initiatives dedicated to students and young professionals:

• Supporting the annual Summer Internship Program

• Acting as one of the key contacts for interns throughout their journey

• Helping create an engaging and positive intern experience

• Participating in employer branding and campus-related initiatives

HR Projects & Innovation

Work on meaningful projects that improve HR processes and employee experience:

• Contribute to the automation of HR administrative workflows

• Participate in digitalization and process improvement initiatives

• Support HR Business Partners on transversal European projects

• Bring your ideas and help shape new ways of working

YOUR PROFILE

You might be the perfect fit if you are:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's (final year) or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field

• Curious about people, organizations and HR careers

• Organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities

• Proactive, detail-oriented and eager to learn

• A collaborative team player with strong communication skills

• Fluent in English and French, both written and spoken

• Additional European languages (Spanish, Italian or Dutch/Flemish)

• Rapports sur les risques du SAEO : Contribuer au tableau de bord mensuel du SAEO et à la préparation de la réunion du Comité de gestion des risques et de tout autre rapport interne ou externe lié à la gestion des risques

• Études en cours en Master/ BA en finance, économie ou domaines connexes

• Apprentissage ouvert et rapide

• Compétences analytiques rigoureuses

• Bonnes compétences en communication

• Compréhension des marchés et produits financiers

• Connaissances de base des techniques de gestion des risques

Internship – AI Engineer - AI in Enterprise Java Application Frameworks

Artificial Intelligence is progressively becoming a core capability of modern enterprise systems. Lombard Odier is exploring how AI services can be integrated into strategic application frameworks to accelerate development, improve user experience and unlock new business capabilities.
You will join the Architecture team and contribute to the definition of future AI integration patterns for Java-based applications built on Spring Boot and Quarkus.

• Evaluate and prototype AI capabilities that can be integrated into enterprise application frameworks used across the bank.

• Research emerging AI technologies and enterprise use cases.

• Explore AI integration patterns for Spring Boot and Quarkus applications.

• Evaluate Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-based architectures.

• Build proof-of-concepts demonstrating AI-enhanced application capabilities.

• Collaborate with software architects and engineering teams.

• Document findings and propose recommendations for future adoption.

YOUR PROFILE

• Master's student in Computer Science or Software Engineering.

• Good Java development skills.

• Interest in Artificial Intelligence and cloud-native technologies.

• Familiarity with Spring Boot, Quarkus or modern application frameworks.

• Curious mindset and willingness to experiment.

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

WHAT YOU WILL GAIN

• Exposure to strategic architecture initiatives.

• Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI and enterprise software engineering.

• Hands-on experience with modern application frameworks.

• Direct collaboration with senior architects and technical leaders.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Stage – Ingénieur logiciel AI - Intelligence relationnelle AI pour la banque privée

Les professionnels de la banque privée interagissent quotidiennement avec un grand nombre de clients, de relations, de conformité et d'informations opérationnelles réparties sur plusieurs systèmes.
Bien que notre plateforme interne de CRM donne accès à de riches ensembles de données, les utilisateurs passent souvent beaucoup de temps à chercher de l'information, à identifier les priorités et à déterminer les actions les plus pertinentes à exécuter.

La prochaine génération de notre CRM est en train de passer des dépôts d'information à des espaces de travail intelligents capables de faire face de façon proactive aux idées, aux risques, aux opportunités et aux actions recommandées.
Ce stage vise à explorer comment l'Intelligence Artificielle peut aider à transformer les données brutes en intelligence actionnable en fournissant des idées significatives, des recommandations et des capacités de soutien à la décision directement dans les flux de travail opérationnels.

Votre rôle

• Rechercher des approches à la fine pointe de la technologie dans le CRM, les systèmes de recommandation, l'IA explicable et les flux de travail des agents.

• Analyser la gestion des relations, la conformité et les données opérationnelles.

• Identifier les événements d'affaires, les signaux comportementaux et les modèles qui peuvent mener à des recommandations proactives.

• Concevoir et développer des capacités intelligentes qui aident les utilisateurs à se concentrer sur ce qui compte le plus.

• Élaborer des modèles de recommandation et de notation permettant de déterminer les mesures, les risques, les possibilités et les goulets d'étranglement opérationnels pertinents.

• Explorer les grands modèles linguistiques et les copilotes d'IA comme mécanismes d'aide à la décision.

• Concevoir des méthodes de recommandation explicables pour aider les utilisateurs à comprendre pourquoi des mesures sont suggérées.

• Prototyper et évaluer les expériences d'IA conversationnelle et visuelle.

• Collaborer avec des équipes de produits, d'affaires et de technologie.

• Mesurer l'adoption par les utilisateurs, la qualité des recommandations et l'impact des activités.

VOTRE PROFIL

• Maîtrise en informatique, informatique ou génie.

• Intérêt pour les systèmes de recommandation et l'IA.

• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

• Connaissance du développement logiciel et du traitement des données.

• Joueur d'équipe avec de solides compétences en communication.

• Résidence en Suisse ou volonté de déménager

Ce que tu vas avoir

• Travailler sur des systèmes intelligents de soutien à la décision.

• Exposition aux applications d'IA ayant un impact commercial direct.

• Possibilité d'influencer la productivité des banquiers et le service à la clientèle.

• Collaboration avec les équipes de produits, d'affaires et de technologie.

L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement indéfectible.

• Design and implement platform capabilities enabling developers to rapidly prototype and test AI-agent solutions in a secure and scalable environment.

• Extend the existing API Portal ecosystem.

• Explore Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

• Develop mock service generation capabilities.

• Build developer-friendly tools and workflows.

• Investigate modern AI agent architectures.

• Work closely with architects and platform engineers.

YOUR PROFILE

• Master's student in Computer Science or Software Engineering.

• Interest in APIs, platform engineering and AI.

• Knowledge of modern programming languages.

• Curiosity and innovation mindset.

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

WHAT YOU WILL GAIN

• Exposure to cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

• Work on technology strategy initiatives.

• Strong architectural and platform engineering experience.

• Opportunity to shape future AI development practices.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Internship – Data Engineer - Accelerating Adoption of Microsoft Fabric

Microsoft Fabric is becoming a key data platform for modern analytics, data engineering and business intelligence. Adoption of such platforms requires not only technology expertise but also a deep understanding of user needs and operational challenges.
You will help drive the successful adoption of Microsoft Fabric across the organization.

YOUR ROLE

• Support the design and implementation of an adoption strategy that maximizes the value delivered by Microsoft Fabric to business and technical users.

• Analyze current usage patterns.

• Identify adoption barriers and opportunities.

• Engage with users and data experts.

• Explore new platform capabilities.

• Design support and enablement initiatives.

• Formulate recommendations for increased adoption.

YOUR PROFILE

• Master's student in Data Science, Data Engineering or Information Systems.

• Strong interest in modern data platforms.

• Analytical and communication skills.

• Ability to interact with diverse stakeholders.

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

WHAT YOU WILL GAIN

• Exposure to a strategic enterprise platform.

• Combination of technology, data and business challenges.

• Strong stakeholder interaction.

• Valuable experience in change and adoption management.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.
descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati ed istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari meglio capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti.

Con una storia che dura oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie.

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti.

Internship – Data Engineer - Accelerare l'adozione di Microsoft Fabric

Microsoft Fabric sta diventando una piattaforma di dati chiave per analisi moderne, ingegneria dei dati e business intelligence. L'adozione di tali piattaforme richiede non solo competenze tecnologiche, ma anche una profonda comprensione delle esigenze degli utenti e delle sfide operative.
Ti aiuterà a guidare l'adozione di successo di Microsoft Fabric in tutta l'organizzazione.

Il tuo!

• Supporta la progettazione e l'implementazione di una strategia di adozione che massimizza il valore fornito da Microsoft Fabric agli utenti aziendali e tecnici.

• Analizzare i modelli di utilizzo attuali.

• Identificare barriere e opportunità di adozione.

• Impegnarsi con utenti e esperti di dati.

• Esplora nuove funzionalità della piattaforma.

• Sostegno alla progettazione e iniziative di abilitazione.

• Formulare raccomandazioni per una maggiore adozione.

Il tuo progetto

• Studente di Master in Informatica, Ingegneria dei Dati o Sistemi Informativi.

• Forte interesse per le moderne piattaforme di dati.

• Capacità analitiche e di comunicazione.

• Capacità di interagire con diversi stakeholder.

• Residence in Svizzera o disponibilità a trasferirsi

Quello che hai detto

• Esposizione a una piattaforma aziendale strategica.

• Combinazione di tecnologie, dati e sfide aziendali.

• Forte interazione degli stakeholder.

• Esperienza preziosa nella gestione del cambiamento e dell'adozione.

Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata.

Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale.

E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nella massima fiducia.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltiges Investieren zu arbeiten. Als innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden ist unsere unabhängige Kanzlei eine der am besten kapitalisierten Bankengruppen der Welt, die fast CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten aus operiert.

Mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ist Lombard Odier ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskretionärem und beratendem Portfoliomanagement, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Verwahrung bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienstleistungen und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Managers und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie für andere Finanzinstitute.

„Rethink Everything ist unsere Philosophie – sie steht im Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker geworden, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu überdenken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten.

Praktikum - Data Engineer - Beschleunigung der Einführung von Microsoft Fabric

Microsoft Fabric entwickelt sich zu einer wichtigen Datenplattform für moderne Analysen, Data Engineering und Business Intelligence. Die Einführung solcher Plattformen erfordert nicht nur Technologie-Know-how, sondern auch ein tiefes Verständnis der Benutzerbedürfnisse und operativen Herausforderungen.
Sie werden dazu beitragen, die erfolgreiche Einführung von Microsoft Fabric in der gesamten Organisation voranzutreiben.

IHRE ROLLE

• Unterstützen Sie die Gestaltung und Implementierung einer Adoptionsstrategie, die den Wert maximiert, den Microsoft Fabric für Geschäfts- und technische Benutzer bietet.

• Analysieren Sie aktuelle Nutzungsmuster.

• Identifizieren Sie Adoptionsbarrieren und -möglichkeiten.

• Engagieren Sie sich mit Benutzern und Datenexperten.

• Entdecken Sie neue Plattformfähigkeiten.

• Design Support und Enablement Initiativen.

• Formulieren Sie Empfehlungen für eine verstärkte Adoption.

IHR PROFIL

• Master-Student in Data Science, Data Engineering oder Information Systems.

• Großes Interesse an modernen Datenplattformen.

• Analyse- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zu interagieren.

• Aufenthalt in der Schweiz oder Umzugsbereitschaft

WAS SIE WERDEN WERDEN

• Exposition gegenüber einer strategischen Unternehmensplattform.

• Kombination von Technologie, Daten und geschäftlichen Herausforderungen.

• Starke Interaktion der Stakeholder.

• Wertvolle Erfahrung im Change- und Adoptionsmanagement.

Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns an, die Besten bei dem zu sein, was wir tun, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt antreibt. Respekt untermauert jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unser Handeln. Zusammen sind wir ein Team, vereint darin, unseren Kunden mit unerschütterlichem Engagement zu dienen.

Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir ein vielfältiges und integratives Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter und Kandidaten. Diversität, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion sind Teil der DNA unserer Maison und wir bemühen uns sicherzustellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter sowohl ihre persönlichen als auch ihre beruflichen Ziele erfüllen können, indem sie die interne Mobilität und individuelle Weiterbildungsprogramme fördern. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass der Aufbau von Diverse Teams zu unseren Erfolgen beiträgt, und um dies zu erreichen, binden wir Diversität, Equity und Inklusion aktiv in unsere Geschäftsstrategie ein.

Es ist eine aufregende Zeit, unseren Teams beizutreten. Alle Anwendungen werden strengstens vertraulich behandelt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de 300 milliards de francs et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux répartis sur 4 continents.

Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières.

Repenser Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients.

Stage – Ingénieur de données - Accélérer l'adoption de Microsoft Fabric

Microsoft Fabric devient une plateforme de données clé pour l'analyse moderne, l'ingénierie des données et l'intelligence d'affaires. L'adoption de telles plates-formes nécessite non seulement une expertise technologique, mais aussi une compréhension approfondie des besoins des utilisateurs et des défis opérationnels.
Vous contribuerez à l'adoption réussie de Microsoft Fabric dans toute l'organisation.

Votre rôle

• Soutenir la conception et la mise en œuvre d'une stratégie d'adoption qui maximise la valeur fournie par Microsoft Fabric aux utilisateurs commerciaux et techniques.

• Analyser les modes d'utilisation actuels.

• Identifier les obstacles et les possibilités d'adoption.

• Engager avec les utilisateurs et les experts en données.

• Explorer de nouvelles capacités de plate-forme.

• Conception d'initiatives de soutien et de facilitation.

• Formuler des recommandations en vue d'une adoption accrue.

VOTRE PROFIL

• Étudiant à la maîtrise en sciences des données, génie des données ou systèmes d'information.

• Intérêt pour les plateformes de données modernes.

• Compétences en analyse et communication.

• Capacité d'interagir avec divers intervenants.

• Résidence en Suisse ou volonté de déménager

Ce que tu vas avoir

• Exposition à une plateforme d'entreprise stratégique.

• Combinaison de technologies, de données et de défis commerciaux.

• Une forte interaction des parties prenantes.

• Expérience précieuse dans la gestion du changement et de l'adoption.

L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement indéfectible.

En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour nos employés et nos candidats. La diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion s'intègrent dans le tissu de notre ADN Maison, et nous nous efforçons de faire en sorte que nos employés puissent réaliser leurs aspirations personnelles et professionnelles en encourageant la mobilité interne et les programmes de perfectionnement individuel. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos succès et, pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans notre stratégie d'affaires.

C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre nos équipes. Toutes les demandes seront traitées avec la plus grande confiance.

Internship – Software Engineer - Competency Graph Administration Platform Modernization

Join the Cash Management team and contribute to the modernization of a critical application used to manage competency rules and operational parameters across key banking processes.

As part of a broader digital transformation initiative, you will redesign and enhance an existing administration platform, replacing legacy technologies with modern frameworks while introducing new self-service capabilities for business users. This project combines software engineering, user experience design, and operational process optimization.

YOUR ROLE

• Modernize an existing administration platform by migrating it from AngularJS to Angular, WildFly to Quarkus and extending its functionality to provide greater autonomy to operational teams.

• Analyze the current application architecture and existing business workflows.

• Migrate frontend components from AngularJS to Angular.

• Migrate backend components from WildFly to Quarkus.

• Develop backend integrations and APIs where required.

• Design and implement new administration and parameterization features based on access rights.

• Implement a context-based split (per application source)

• Improve usability and user experience for operational teams.

• Ensure application quality through automated testing and code reviews.

• Collaborate closely with Developers, Operations teams, and Business Analysts.

YOUR PROFILE

• Master's student in Computer Science or Software Engineering.

• Knowledge of Angular or modern frontend frameworks.

• Interest in full-stack development and user experience.

• Understanding of Java-based applications is a plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

• Hands-on experience with application modernization.

• Exposure to operational banking processes.

• Opportunity to deliver features used daily by business teams.

• Experience with modern frontend and enterprise application development.

IL TUO RUOLO

Il Responsabile dell'Identity & Access Management (IAM Manager) supervisiona tutte le attività relative alla gestione delle identità e degli accessi per garantire la sicurezza, l'integrità e la conformità dei sistemi informativi. Guidano il team IAM (amministratori, analisti), definiscono la visione e la strategia IAM e garantiscono che gli utenti giusti abbiano il giusto accesso ai sistemi giusti al momento giusto.

L’IAM Manager svolge un ruolo chiave nella protezione del patrimonio informativo aziendale garantendo l’allineamento tra esigenze aziendali, requisiti di sicurezza e obblighi normativi.

Questo ruolo include:

Leadership e gestione:

• Definire obiettivi operativi, monitorare le prestazioni, gestire le priorità e garantire la qualità del servizio.

• Supervisionare le attività relative a SLA, KPI di sicurezza e indicatori di conformità.

Governance e strategia IAM:

• Definire, mantenere e sviluppare la strategia IAM, inclusa la governance dell'identità (IGA).

• Sviluppare e applicare politiche, standard e procedure in linea con i quadri normativi.

• Implementare e supervisionare controlli, audit e revisioni periodiche degli accessi.

Collaborazione e integrazione IT/aziendale:

• Soluzioni integrate di co-progettazione.

• Collaborare con le risorse umane, i team aziendali e il management per facilitare i processi di onboarding, mobilità e offboarding.

• Sensibilizzare i dipendenti sulle migliori pratiche.

Tecnologia e innovazione:

• Guidare la roadmap della tecnologia IAM: modernizzazione, automazione, integrazione di nuovi strumenti e miglioramenti del flusso di lavoro.

• Mantenere un monitoraggio attivo delle tendenze del settore.

IL TUO PROFILO

Sai come e divertiti:

• Costruire, guidare e sviluppare un team.

• Esplorare nuovi argomenti, apprendere e approfondire la conoscenza.

• Definire una visione e circondarsi delle persone giuste per realizzarla.

• Comunicare con le parti interessate sia tecniche che non tecniche.

• Progettare ed erogare servizi a valore aggiunto.

• Lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e complesso.

• Assumersi rischi calcolati nell'ambito della propria responsabilità.

Idealmente:

• Hai una solida conoscenza delle soluzioni IAM (CyberArk, Okta o simili).

• Hai familiarità con i concetti chiave dell'IAM (RBAC, Need-to-Know, Need-to-Do).

• La tua esperienza include la partecipazione a audit interni o esterni.

NB: Si ricorda che, in conformità alle leggi vigenti e ai requisiti del ruolo, al candidato selezionato sarà richiesto di fornire un estratto del casellario giudiziale (sezione 3).

Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L’eccellenza ci spinge a essere i migliori in ciò che facciamo, mentre l’innovazione alimenta il nostro progresso. Il rispetto è alla base di ogni interazione e l'integrità modella le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un unico team, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con incrollabile dedizione.

In qualità di datore di lavoro responsabile e solidale, promuoviamo un approccio diversificato e inclusivo

L'équipe de déclaration de l'impôt offre un environnement de travail collaboratif et habilitant avec des modalités de travail souples. Vous rejoindrez une équipe de spécialistes expérimentés opérant dans un paysage fiscal dynamique et évolutif.

Votre rôle

• Gérer la planification et la production des relevés fiscaux pour les clients Lombard Odier et BPO ;

• Suivre les exigences des entreprises et participer aux tests dans le cadre de l'élaboration de l'application de déclaration d'impôt interne ;

• Fournir un soutien pour l'analyse des données sur les sujets liés à l'impôt ;

• Élaborer et maintenir des procédures opérationnelles

VOTRE PROFIL

• Baccalauréat en finance, administration des affaires ou équivalent considéré comme un avantage, bien qu'une CCF suisse ou la maturité professionnelle Bancaire sera également considérée.

• L'expérience antérieure en matière de déclaration fiscale ou dans un domaine connexe serait très appréciée.

• Joueur d'équipe proactif et enthousiaste avec d'excellentes compétences en communication, un état d'esprit collaboratif, une curiosité intellectuelle et un sens fort de la responsabilité.

• Excellentes compétences en gestion interpersonnelle et des intervenants, avec la capacité d'établir des relations de confiance, de collaborer entre les fonctions et de prospérer dans un environnement dynamique et évolutif.

• Fluent en anglais et/ou en français (écrit et parlé). D'autres langues sont considérées comme un atout (allemand, italien, espagnol, etc.).

Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie.

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti.

Business Transformation Manager – Operazioni (80-100%)

Le operazioni sono al centro della capacità della Banca di offrire eccellenza ai clienti, adeguandosi ad un ambiente sempre più complesso ed in evoluzione.
Per sostenere la nostra ambizione a lungo termine, abbiamo lanciato l'Operazione 2030 Strategy, un viaggio trasformativo progettato per costruire un'organizzazione più scalabile, efficiente, data-driven e futura. Questo include ripensare il nostro modello operativo, accelerare l'adozione di AI e automazione, rafforzare la qualità dei dati e la governance, modernizzare il nostro panorama tecnologico e sviluppare le competenze necessarie per il futuro.

In qualità di Business Transformation Manager, ti unirai all'Operazioni Transformation Office, un team piccolo e ben visibile responsabile della guida di questa agenda strategica. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i leader senior in Operazioni, Tecnologia, Data Office, HR e Control Functions, vi aiuterà a modellare, coordinare e fornire iniziative che avranno un impatto duraturo sul modo in cui Operazioni opera in tutta la Banca.

Questa posizione offre un'opportunità unica per combinare il pensiero strategico con l'esecuzione pratica, acquisendo un'ampia esposizione agli stakeholder senior e priorità di trasformazione chiave. Se il vostro background è in consulenza, gestione dei programmi o operazioni bancarie, si svolgerà un ruolo centrale nel trasformare le ambizioni strategiche in risultati aziendali tangibili.

Il tuo!

Come Business Transformation Manager, agirai come catalizzatore per il cambiamento, assicurando che le iniziative strategiche vengano tradotte in risultati misurabili.
Lo farai:

• Guidare la consegna di iniziative chiave all'interno della roadmap Operazioni 2030, dalla pianificazione all'implementazione.

• Coordinate i programmi complessi e interfunzionali che coinvolgono le funzioni Operazioni, Tecnologia, Data Office, HR e Controllo.

• Stabilire e mantenere efficaci quadri di governance, comitati di guida e meccanismi di reporting esecutivo.

• Monitorare i progressi del programma, le pietre miliari, i rischi, le dipendenze e la creazione di valore per garantire la consegna di successo.

• Sfida i processi e le modalità di lavoro esistenti, identifica le opportunità per semplificare, ottimizzare e migliorare le prestazioni operative.

• Facilitare il processo decisionale esecutivo attraverso analisi, raccomandazioni e presentazioni di alta qualità.

• Sostenere l'implementazione di iniziative relative alla trasformazione del modello operativo, digitalizzazione, dati, automazione e AI.

• Promuovere l'allineamento e la collaborazione tra diversi gruppi di stakeholder in un ambiente matrice.

• Contribuire a cambiare gli sforzi di gestione e aiutare a guidare l'adozione in team colpiti.

Il tuo progetto

• Si può provenire da una società di consulenza, un ufficio di trasformazione, una funzione di gestione del programma o un ruolo di leadership operativa all'interno dei servizi finanziari.

• Professionista attivo e orientato ai risultati che combina forti capacità analitiche con la capacità di influenzare e guidare il cambiamento.

• Esperienza comprovata nella trasformazione aziendale, nella consulenza, nella gestione del progetto/programma o nel bus

This includes rethinking our operating model, accelerating the adoption of AI and automation, strengthening data quality and governance, modernising our technology landscape, and developing the skills needed for the future.

Working closely with senior leaders across Operations, Technology, Data Office, HR and Control Functions, you will help shape, coordinate and deliver initiatives that will have a lasting impact on the way Operations operates across the Bank.

Whether your background is in consulting, programme management or banking operations, you will play a central role in turning strategic ambitions into tangible business outcomes.

YOUR ROLE

As a Business Transformation Manager, you will act as a catalyst for change, ensuring that strategic initiatives are translated into measurable results.
You will:

• Drive the delivery of key initiatives within the Operations 2030 roadmap, from planning to implementation.

• Coordinate complex, cross-functional programmes involving Operations, Technology, Data Office, HR and Control Functions.

• Establish and maintain effective governance frameworks, steering committees and executive reporting mechanisms.

• Monitor programme progress, milestones, risks, dependencies and value creation to ensure successful delivery.

• Challenge existing processes and ways of working, identifying opportunities to simplify, optimise and enhance operational performance.

• Facilitate executive decision-making through high-quality analyses, recommendations and presentations.

• Support the implementation of initiatives related to operating model transformation, digitalisation, data, automation and AI.

• Foster alignment and collaboration across diverse stakeholder groups in a matrix environment.

• Contribute to change management efforts and help drive adoption across impacted teams.

YOUR PROFILE

• You may come from a consulting firm, a transformation office, a programme management function or an operational leadership role within financial services.

• Proactive and results-oriented professional who combines strong analytical capabilities with the ability to influence and drive change.

• Proven experience in business transformation, consulting, project/programme management or bus

Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati ed istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari meglio capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti.

Con una storia che dura oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie.

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti.

Lavorando all’interno del team di Investimento Sostenibile, l’Analista per la Ricerca Sostenibilità svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell’attuazione, nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento continuo del quadro di investimento sostenibile di Lombard Odier. Garantire credibilità e coerenza, questa funzione è fondamentale per l’offerta di investimento sostenibile dell’azienda e comporta interazioni con i team di investimento e altri stakeholder interni attraverso la gestione patrimoniale e le attività bancarie private. Le responsabilità iniziali si concentreranno sull’applicazione del quadro alle valutazioni di sostenibilità, con lo scopo nel tempo di prendere possesso di specifici flussi di lavoro relativi allo sviluppo e all’attuazione del quadro.

Analista di ricerca di sostenibilità (80-100%)

Il tuo ruolo:

• Valutare le aziende e etichettare gli strumenti di debito contro il framework di investimento sostenibile proprietario dell’azienda utilizzando le informative aziendali, i dati di sostenibilità di terzi e altre fonti esterne; autorizzare valutazioni scritte per l’uso interno e client-facing

• Contribuire al continuo sviluppo di criteri quadro qualitativi attraverso la ricerca nel settore e nella catena del valore; sostenere i miglioramenti ai criteri di framework basati sui dati sfruttando i set di dati esterni e gli strumenti interni.

• Monitorare gli sviluppi in materia di regolamentazione, standard, framework e temi di sostenibilità emergenti

• Lavora con i team di investimento e altri stakeholder interni per spiegare gli output di valutazione, sostenere nuove idee di investimento e rispondere alle richieste di due diligence legate alla sostenibilità o ai clienti

• Contribuire a migliorare i flussi di lavoro e la documentazione relativa al quadro di investimento sostenibile e ai processi di investimento, anche attraverso l'introduzione dei flussi di lavoro abilitati all'IA

• Generare intuizioni di ricerca e collaborare con il team di stewardship di investimento sul coinvolgimento aziendale

Il tuo profilo:

• Titolo di laurea o post-laurea in sostenibilità, scienze ambientali, politica pubblica o un campo correlato; esperienza professionale orientata alla sostenibilità può sostituire uno sfondo accademico specifico per la sostenibilità

• Esperienza prioritaria nella ricerca sulla sostenibilità/ESG, consulenza sulla sostenibilità, finanza sostenibile o mercati dei capitali sostenibili

• Esperienza dimostrata analizzando aziende, settori, modelli di business e divulgazione aziendale dalla prospettiva di rischi, opportunità e impatti legati alla sostenibilità

• Forte comprensione dei problemi di sostenibilità ambientale e sociale e delle loro interconnessioni, nonché dei quadri di sostenibilità, delle certificazioni e degli standard

• La curiosità intellettuale e la capacità di pensare concettualmente alle intersezioni dei mercati finanziari, delle prestazioni aziendali e delle questioni ambientali e sociali

• Comfort con ambiguità e giudizio con dati incompleti o imperfetti

• Capacità di interpretare e organizzare complesse informazioni qualitative e quantitative

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e di prendere la proprietà dei progetti

An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Working within the Sustainable Investing team, the Sustainability Research Analyst will play an integral role in the implementation, development and ongoing enhancement of Lombard Odier’s proprietary sustainable investment framework. By ensuring credibility and consistency, this function is central to the firm’s sustainable investment offering and entails interactions with investment teams and other internal stakeholders across the firm’s asset management and private banking activities. Initial responsibilities will focus on the application of the framework to sustainability assessments, with scope over time to take ownership of specific workstreams related to the framework’s development and implementation.

Sustainability Research Analyst (80-100%)

Your Role :

• Assess companies and labelled debt instruments against the firm’s proprietary sustainable investment framework using company disclosures, third-party sustainability data, and other external sources; author written assessments for internal and client-facing use

• Contribute to the continued development of qualitative framework criteria through sector and value chain research; support improvements to data-driven framework criteria by leveraging external datasets and internal tools.

• Monitor developments in sustainability regulation, standards, frameworks, and emerging sustainability themes

• Work with investment teams and other internal stakeholders to explain assessment outputs, support new investment ideas and respond to sustainability-related due diligence or client requests

• Contribute to improving workflows and documentation related to the sustainable investment framework and investment processes, including through the introduction of AI-enabled workflows

• Generate research insights and collaborate with the investment stewardship team on company engagement

Your Profile :

• Degree or postgraduate qualification in sustainability, environmental science, public policy or a related field; sustainability-focused professional experience may substitute for a sustainability-specific academic background

• Prior experience in sustainability/ESG research, sustainability consulting, sustainable finance, or sustainable capital markets

• Demonstrated experience analysing companies, sectors, business models and corporate disclosures from the perspective of sustainability-related risks, opportunities and impacts

• Strong understanding of environmental and social sustainability issues and their interconnections, as well as sustainability frameworks, certifications and standards

• Intellectual curiosity and the ability to think conceptually about the intersections of financial markets, corporate performance, and environmental and social issues

• Comfort with ambiguity and making judgments with incomplete or imperfect data

• Ability to interpret and organise complex qualitative and quantitative information

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects

YOUR ROLE

Change Management

HR Operational Excellence

• Ensure quality and consistency of HR processes within the BU (Talent review, performance review & Objectif setting, yearly compensation review)

• Maintain social compliance and a healthy work environment (labor relations, psychosocial risk prevention)

• Leverage HR data and analytics to produce actionable insights for the business

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven experience (3+ years) as an HR Business Partner in a demanding environment

• Results-oriented with a strong sense of priorities

• Comfortable with ambiguity

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Payment Specialist (80-100%) (12-month contract)

As part of our Technology & Operations unit, and more specifically within the Operations department, in an environment of constant technological and regulatory change, we are looking to strengthen the Payment Transactions department. You will join a team of nine people responsible for controlling and executing transfer orders.

YOUR ROLE

• Process account closures accurately and promptly to adhere to regulatory requirements and internal policies, ensuring smooth account management transitions for clients.

• Analyze, control, and execute various types of incoming payments, including client incoming funds, bank-to-bank transfers, and manual entries, to manage cash flows effectively and maintain accurate financial records.

• Analyze, control, and execute different types of outgoing payments, such as customer payments, bank-to-bank transfers, standing orders, QR payments, managing pending LSVs, and processing DTA/CSV/SAP files, to facilitate seamless and secure fund transfers.

• Manage the bank's various mailboxes efficiently, responding to inquiries and requests from internal clients in a timely and professional manner to provide excellent customer service and support.

• Process management fees accurately and in compliance with established guidelines to ensure correct billing and financial reporting.

• Manage broadcast and analyze requests from Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partners for changes in correspondent relationships, ensuring smooth communication and operational efficiency.

• Conduct investigations and resolve pending reconciliations related to outgoing payments, incoming funds, and correspondent fees meticulously to uphold financial accuracy and resolve discrepancies promptly.

• Actively participate in IT projects, contributing insights and expertise to drive successful project outcomes and enhance operational systems for improved efficiency and effectiveness

YOUR PROFILE

• Professional Maturity from a business school or CFC

• Experience 3 to 5 years in banking operations, more specifically to payments (SWIFT, SIC, EUROSIC, SEPA)

• Ability to maintain strong knowledge of SWIFT messages

• Work effectively in a team, be flexible and dynamic

• Demonstrate excellent communication skills and respect

• Exhibit resistance to stress

• Display strong time management and prioritization skills

• Possess excellent analytical and critical skills

• Implement improvements and innovation (new ideas or methods to execute certain tasks)

• Be proficient in French and English (level B2 or above), with other languages as a plus

• Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Securities Transfer Specialist (80-100%) (12-month contract)

Within the Technology & Operations unit, Securities transfer team is in charge of the end-to-end process for securities transfer free of payment. The successful candidate will work in a team of 20 employees.

YOUR ROLE

• Execute internal transfer

• Analyse and take in charge cost corrections.

• Create deposit securities entry into the client account.

• Communicate and exchange SSI and matching details with counterparties.

• Place instructions on the market (Swift) as per market practice rules and market guide

• Place instructions for funds as per Transfer agent rules

• Solve settlement pending issues (regulated market and funds)

• Confirm trade as per contract note receive from Transfer Agent

• Communicate and support front office

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor degree in Finance or Business Administration or equivalent considered an advantage but “CFC”/”Maturité professionnel bancaire” also considered

• Banking experience of at least 3 to 5 years in a similar position

• Excellent communication skills (client oriented)

• Reactivity- Ability to manage emergencies and contingencies.

• Managing Priorities, ability to work efficiently under pressure.

• Excellent skills in analyzing and understanding flows.

• Good knowledge of SWIFT messages

• Fluent in French and English (B2 minimum).

• Knowledge of securities, and securities processing (included Funds)

• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate to Switzerland.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.
