Trainee - Database Administration & Observability Specialist (Foglight / Elastic) Nell'ambito del rafforzamento della supervisione del database e dell'implementazione di una piattaforma di conformità centralizzata, il team DBA sta cercando un tirocinante per accompagnare un progetto strategico attorno a Foglight (controllo database) e la sua integrazione con la piattaforma Elastic utilizzata a livello bancario. Questo corso offre un'esposizione concreta agli ambienti bancari critici, alle moderne tecnologie di supervisione e a un progetto trasversale che coinvolge diversi team IT (DBA, Systems, Security, Observability). Il tirocinante accompagnerà il team DBA nel monitoraggio, coordinamento, implementazione e documentazione del progetto Foglight, nonché nella sua integrazione con la piattaforma di osservazione elastica. Il corso combina:
• Gestione funzionale del progetto,
• Attuazione tecnica supervisionata,
• Comunicazione e documentazione,
• Scopri buone pratiche di vigilanza bancaria. LA TUA MISSIONE 1. Steering e coordinamento del progetto Foglight
• Partecipa al follow-up della pianificazione globale Foglight & Elastic .
• Organizzare e coordinare incontri con:
• Le varie tecnologie DB del team DBA,
• Squadre di Sistemi, Sicurezza e Osservabilità.
• Preparare i rapporti, le tabelle di monitoraggio e le relazioni di progresso.
• Contribuire al flusso regolare di informazioni tra le squadre. 2. Attuazione della supervisione di Foglight Accompagnato da esperti DBA, lo stage parteciperà a:
• Aggiungere Test / UAT / Ambienti di produzione in Foglight.
• La convalida delle metriche raccolte per i diversi GBS.
• Creazione di dashboard sanitari di alto livello per tecnologia.
• Definizione e impostazione di avvisi rilevanti .
• Integrazione con ServiceNow per l'apertura automatica degli incidenti.
• Integrazione con Elastico per il sollevamento delle metriche di monitoraggio. 3. Documentazione e strutturazione
• Scrivere e mantenere la documentazione del progetto.
• Produrre documentazione funzionale di Foglight → Integrazione elastica.
• Crea guide utente e procedure interne per i team IT. 4. Supporto per la formazione interna
• Preparare materiali di formazione (presentazioni, guide).
• Contribuire all'organizzazione e al regolare funzionamento delle sessioni di formazione interna su Foglight e Elastic. 5. Comunicazione e visibilità del progetto
• Preparare comunicazioni interne formali relative al progetto.
• Aggiornamento Confluenza / Spazi di squadra.
• Partecipare alla comunicazione su soggetti di osservabilità all'interno della banca. Missioni specifiche – Osservabilità elastica
• Raccogliere e formalizzare i requisiti di Elastic metric, alert e dashboard.
• descrivere funzionale Foglight → flussi di dati elastici.
• Coordinate scambi tra il team DBA e il Team O

Le/la stagiaire accompagnera l’équipe DBA dans le suivi, la coordination, le déploiement et la documentation du projet Foglight, ainsi que dans son intégration avec la plateforme d’observabilité Elastic .

Le stage combine :

• Pilotage fonctionnel de projet,

• Mise en œuvre technique encadrée,

• Communication et documentation,

• Découverte des bonnes pratiques de supervision en milieu bancaire.

VOTRE MISSION

1. Pilotage et coordination du projet Foglight

• Participer au suivi du planning global Foglight & Elastic .

• Organiser et coordonner les réunions avec :

• Les référents des différentes technologies DB au sein de l’équipe DBA,

• Les équipes Systèmes, Sécurité et Observabilité.

• Préparer les comptes-rendus , tableaux de suivi et reportings d’avancement.

• Contribuer à la circulation fluide de l’information entre les équipes.

2. Implémentation de la supervision Foglight

Accompagné(e) par les experts DBA, le/la stagiaire participera à :

• L’ajout des environnements Test / UAT / Production dans Foglight.

• La validation des métriques collectées pour les différents SGBD.

• La création de dashboards de santé haut niveau par technologie.

• La définition et le paramétrage des alertes pertinentes .

• L’intégration avec ServiceNow pour l’ouverture automatique d’incidents.

• L’intégration avec Elastic pour la remontée des métriques de supervision.

3. Documentation et structuration

• Rédiger et maintenir la documentation projet .

• Produire la documentation fonctionnelle de l’intégration Foglight → Elastic .

• Créer des guides utilisateurs et procédures internes destinés aux équipes IT.

4. Support à la formation interne

• Préparer des supports de formation (présentations, guides).

• Contribuer à l’organisation et au bon déroulement de sessions de formation internes sur Foglight et Elastic.

5. Communication et visibilité du projet

• Préparer les communications internes officielles liées au projet.

• Mettre à jour les espaces Confluence / Teams .

• Participer à la communication autour des sujets d’ observabilité au sein de la banque.

Missions spécifiques – Observabilité Elastic

• Recueillir et formaliser les besoins en métriques, alertes et dashboards Elastic.

descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Internship - Data Scientist

As part of the deployment of AI Copilot agents, we are looking to structure a monitoring framework to effectively manage their performance, quality, and adoption, while keeping associated costs under control.

YOUR ROLE

The intern will contribute to the definition and implementation of a monitoring framework covering:

• Response quality : defining metrics (accuracy, relevance, hallucination rate), and implementing (automated) evaluation mechanisms

• Performance and stability : monitoring response times, error rates, availability, and robustness of agents

• User adoption : tracking usage, analyzing user journeys, measuring satisfaction (feedback, NPS, reuse rate)

• Costs and FINOps : monitoring inference and usage costs, optimizing the value-to-cost ratio

Development environment and industrialization:

• Contributing to the structuring of a standardized Sandbox environment in collaboration with IT Infrastructure teams

• Implementing resource variability (Outlook, SharePoint, Teams, etc.) to facilitate production deployment

• Writing recommendations and best practices for integration, deployment, and industrialization of agents

Expected Deliverables

• A structured framework (metrics, dashboards, standards)

• Recommendations on architecture, processes, and development environment

• A first version of the monitoring solution (e.g., dashboards or automated reporting)

• Guidelines for setup, configuration, and resource variability

YOUR PROFILE

• Student in engineering school / Data Science

• Specialization in AI, LLMs, and production deployment challenges

• Comfortable with data analysis and technical environments

• Strong organizational skills, autonomy, and critical thinking

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

Stiamo cercando un Storage & Backup Engineer con una forte passione per l'infrastruttura aziendale, la protezione dei dati e l'automazione. Ti unirai a un team dinamico di 15 esperti di ingegneria del sistema che gestiscono un'infrastruttura globale di oltre 7.000 server, piattaforme di storage enterprise multiple e servizi di backup mission-critical che supportano le operazioni della Banca in tutto il mondo. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella progettazione, il funzionamento e l'evoluzione del nostro ecosistema di archiviazione e backup, tra cui tessuti SAN, array di storage enterprise, tecnologie di replica e piattaforme di protezione dei dati. Garantirai la disponibilità, le prestazioni e la scalabilità delle infrastrutture critiche che supportano applicazioni e servizi aziendali.

Le tue responsabilità includono la gestione e l'ottimizzazione di array di storage, switch SAN e configurazioni di zoning, soluzioni di replica Active-Active, piattaforme di backup e ripristino, nonché il monitoraggio delle prestazioni e la pianificazione della capacità attraverso il paesaggio di storage.

LA TUA MISSIONE

• Progettazione, gestione ed evoluzione delle infrastrutture di storage, SAN e Backup aziendali

• Assicurare le prestazioni, la disponibilità e la resilienza dei servizi di archiviazione e protezione dei dati critici

• Contribuire a progetti di modernizzazione delle infrastrutture, tra cui la replica, il ripristino dei disastri e le tecnologie di storage degli oggetti

• Guidare le iniziative di automazione per migliorare l'efficienza operativa e ridurre l'intervento manuale

• Proporre soluzioni innovative per ottimizzare i servizi, migliorare l'affidabilità e ridurre Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)

• Mantenere la documentazione accurata e garantire il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza e governance

Il tuo progetto

• Istruzione superiore in informatica o sistemi di comunicazione

• Minimo 2 anni di esperienza nel settore

• Forte conoscenza delle tecnologie enterprise Storage e Backup

• Esperienza comprovata gestione array di storage e infrastrutture SAN

• Forte comprensione dell'analisi delle prestazioni di storage, della risoluzione dei problemi e della pianificazione della capacità

• Esperienza con tecnologie di replica Active-Active e soluzioni di disaster recovery

• Buona conoscenza di SAN commutazione, protocolli Fibre Channel e concetti di zoning

• Buona conoscenza delle tecnologie di storage degli oggetti compatibili con S3

• Esperienza con automazione utilizzando Ansible, Python, PowerShell o tecnologie simili

• Esperienza con uno o più dei seguenti prodotti: Hitachi, NetApp, Pure Storage, Brocade, Commvault

• La conoscenza delle tecnologie di virtualizzazione, in particolare VMware, è considerata una risorsa

• La familiarità con le tecnologie dell'infrastruttura Microsoft (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, System Center) è un plus

• La comprensione delle tecnologie di autenticazione e sicurezza come Kerberos, PKI o ADFS è vantaggiosa

• Set mentale strutturato, analitico, proattivo e orientato alla soluzione

• Fluente in entrambi F

Storage Engineer (80-100%)

We are looking for a Storage & Backup Engineer with a strong passion for enterprise infrastructure, data protection, and automation. You will join a dynamic team of 15 system engineering experts who manage a global infrastructure of more than 7,000 servers, multiple enterprise storage platforms, and mission-critical backup services supporting the Bank's operations worldwide. This is a large-scale technical environment where reliability, performance, resilience, and innovation are at the core of our mission.

You will play a key role in the design, operation, and evolution of our storage and backup ecosystem, including SAN fabrics, enterprise storage arrays, replication technologies, and data protection platforms. You will ensure the availability, performance, and scalability of critical infrastructure supporting business applications and services.

Your responsibilities will include the management and optimization of storage arrays, SAN switches and zoning configurations, Active-Active replication solutions, backup and recovery platforms, as well as performance monitoring and capacity planning across the storage landscape.

YOUR MISSION

• Design, manage, and evolve enterprise Storage, SAN, and Backup infrastructures

• Ensure the performance, availability, and resiliency of critical data storage and protection services

• Contribute to infrastructure modernization projects, including replication, disaster recovery, and object storage technologies

• Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention

• Propose innovative solutions to optimize services, enhance reliability, and reduce Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)

• Maintain accurate documentation and ensure compliance with security and governance standards

YOUR PROFILE

• Higher education in computer science or communication systems

• Minimum 2 years of experience in the field

• Strong knowledge of enterprise Storage and Backup technologies

• Proven experience managing storage arrays and SAN infrastructures

• Strong understanding of storage performance analysis, troubleshooting, and capacity planning

• Experience with Active-Active replication technologies and disaster recovery solutions

• Good knowledge of SAN switching, Fibre Channel protocols, and zoning concepts

• Good knowledge of S3-compatible object storage technologies

• Experience with automation using Ansible, Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies

• Experience with one or more of the following products: Hitachi, NetApp, Pure Storage, Brocade, Commvault

• Knowledge of virtualization technologies, especially VMware, is considered an asset

• Familiarity with Microsoft infrastructure technologies (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, System Center) is a plus

• Understanding of authentication and security technologies such as Kerberos, PKI, or ADFS is advantageous

• Structured, analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset

• Fluent in both F

• Research the characteristics of financial instruments on our Data Feed providers (Bloomberg, Telekurs, Reuters, Interactive Data)

• Knowledge of usual financial instruments

• Responsible, rigorous, autonomous and motivated individual who can adapt to different working environments. Strong sense of priorities and team spirit

• Ability to work under stress and absorb high volumes of work

• Fluency in French and English, any other language would be an asset.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Group Risk Assurance Controls Manager (80–100%)

We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and strategic Risk Assurance Controls Manager to join the Operational Risk Management department in Switzerland. This role sits within the second line of defense and carries full ownership of the Group’s risk assurance and control testing framework, including the design, execution, and continuous enhancement of assurance plans.
The successful candidate will lead and develop control testing activities across the organization, provide independent oversight over first line risk and control frameworks, and deliver high-impact insights to senior management and governance bodies. The role includes direct line management responsibility and requires a strong ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

YOUR ROLE
Leadership & Ownership

• Own, design, and continuously enhance the Group-wide risk assurance control testing framework and annual assurance plan

• Lead and develop a small team (1 FTE), providing coaching, priority setting, and performance oversight

• Act as a subject matter expert and key point of contact for control assurance topics across the organization

• Drive consistency, quality, and efficiency in control testing methodologies and outputs

Control Testing Strategy & Execution

• Define, implement, and execute a risk-based control testing strategy aligned with regulatory expectations and internal priorities

• Oversee and perform periodic and ad-hoc control testing across business units and processes

• Ensure comprehensive coverage of key risks and controls, with a forward-looking and thematic approach

• Challenge the design and operating effectiveness of controls, identifying systemic weaknesses and emerging risks

• Ensure high-quality documentation of testing procedures, results, and conclusions

Second Line of Defense Oversight

• Provide independent oversight and challenge of first line risk management and control frameworks

• Assess the adequacy of Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and other first line control activities

• Engage with senior stakeholders to provide expert opinions on control effectiveness and risk exposure

• Collaborate with Internal Audit and other assurance functions to ensure alignment and avoid duplication

Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

• Deliver clear, concise, and impactful reporting to senior management, risk committees, and governing bodies

• Escalate key issues, trends, and systemic control weaknesses in a timely manner

• Provide actionable recommendations to strengthen the control environment and mitigate risks

• Act as a trusted advisor to business and control functions on control design and assurance matters

Issue Management & Follow-up

• Oversee the tracking and validation of remediation actions for identified control deficiencies

• Ensure timely closure of issues and appropriate root cause analysis

• Monitor recurring themes and drive improvements at a structural level

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera in Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato gestore patrimoniale e patrimoniale globale, con una forte attenzione agli investimenti sostenibili. Una banca innovativa scelta da clienti privati ​​e istituzionali, la nostra società di proprietà indipendente è uno dei gruppi bancari meglio capitalizzati al mondo, gestendo quasi 300 miliardi di franchi svizzeri e operando da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia che dura da oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione di portafoglio discrezionale e di consulenza, servizi patrimoniali e custodia. Offriamo inoltre servizi di gestione patrimoniale e strategie di investimento tramite Lombard Odier Investment Managers e forniamo tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altri istituti finanziari. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo diventati più forti attraverso oltre 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo che ci circonda per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento ai nostri clienti. Specialista in indagini antiriciclaggio e segnalazione di attività sospette (SAR) (80-100%) L'individuo lavorerà come membro del team AML-Investigations & Sanctions del gruppo, che fa parte della conformità del gruppo. Le responsabilità includeranno indagini antiriciclaggio, analisi delle indagini, archiviazione SAR, gestione dei dati dei casi, reporting, formazione e contributo al miglioramento continuo del controllo nell'ambito della conformità alla criminalità finanziaria. IL VOSTRO RUOLO:
• Intraprendere indagini antiriciclaggio in casi di sospetto riciclaggio di denaro e relativi reati presupposto.
• Eseguire analisi investigative sull'attività transazionale e sugli eventi scatenanti AML.
• Preparare le richieste AML/SAR e dare seguito alle richieste per il comitato di due diligence svizzero (DDC) e il comitato di due diligence di gruppo (GDDC).
• Presentare le segnalazioni di attività sospette (SAR) al MROS svizzero e gestire le richieste di follow-up.
• Assistenza agli ordini giudiziari svizzeri in stretta collaborazione con l'Unità legale.
• Coordinare casi AML e SAR multientità e multigiurisdizionali nei paesi in cui operiamo.
• Condurre indagini ad hoc di due diligence rafforzata (EDD).
• Supporto nella comunicazione con la FINMA, ove richiesto, compresa la preparazione di input per le richieste normative e la vigilanza continua.
• Produrre regolari report AML/SAR sulle informazioni di gestione (MI).
• Fungere da punto di contatto per le indagini antiriciclaggio e la consulenza SAR per tutti i colleghi del Gruppo.
• Contribuire alla formazione AML/SAR, aggiornando i moduli di e-learning AML/SAR, tenendo presentazioni e producendo materiali di formazione.
• Analizzare le indagini antiriciclaggio e i rapporti SAR per proporre miglioramenti del controllo e identificare le tendenze antiriciclaggio emergenti.
• Mantenere la procedura operativa standard (SOP) del team AML/SAR.
• Organizzare e partecipare alla chiamata di feedback mensile del gruppo relativa ai responsabili della segnalazione di riciclaggio di denaro (MLRO).
• Mantenere una conoscenza approfondita delle leggi e dei regolamenti AML/SAR e delle tendenze della criminalità finanziaria in materia di riciclaggio di denaro.
• Lavorare in stretta collaborazione con il team Sanzioni del Gruppo sui casi di antiriciclaggio e sovrapposizione di sanzioni. IL TUO PROFILO:
• 3-6 anni di esperienza in indagini antiriciclaggio in un ambiente bancario e conoscenza della segnalazione di attività sospette o di funzioni di conformità simili.
• Laurea in Giurisprudenza/Economia o studi comparabili o esperienza lavorativa equivalente nel settore finanziario.
• Forti capacità analitiche e informatiche (è auspicabile la conoscenza dell'applicazione GoAML).
• Flessibilità, adattabilità con buon intuito e capacità di problem solving.
• Buone capacità comunicative, di networking e organizzative.
• Capacità di stabilire le priorità e di lavorare sotto pressione durante indagini antiriciclaggio impegnative e frenetiche.
• Giocatore di squadra con buone capacità comunicative con un elevato standard di inglese scritto e parlato.
• Domiciliato in Svizzera (con sede a Ginevra). Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L’eccellenza ci spinge a essere i migliori in ciò che facciamo, mentre l’innovazione alimenta il nostro progresso. Il rispetto è alla base di ogni interazione e l'integrità modella le nostre azioni

A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

AML Investigations and Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR) Specialist (80-100%)

The individual will work as a member of the Group AML-Investigations & Sanctions team, which forms part of Group Compliance. Responsibilities will include AML Investigations, investigation analytics, SAR filing, case data management, reporting, training and contribution to continuous control improvements across Financial Crime Compliance.

YOUR ROLE:

• Undertake AML Investigations into cases of suspected money laundering and related predicate offences.

• Perform investigative analysis on transactional activity and AML trigger events.

• Prepare AML/SAR submissions and follow up submissions for the Swiss due diligence committee (DDC) and Group due diligence committee (GDDC).

• File suspicious activity reports (SAR's) with the Swiss MROS and manage follow‑up queries.

• Service Swiss judicial orders in close collaboration with the Legal unit.

• Coordinate AML and SAR multi entity and multi-jurisdictional cases in the countries in which we operate.

• Conduct ad-hoc enhanced due diligence investigations (EDD).

• Support in communication with FINMA, where required, including preparation of inputs for regulatory requests and ongoing supervision.

• Produce regular management information (MI) AML/SAR reports.

• Act as a point of contact for AML Investigations and SAR advice for all colleagues within the Group.

• Contribute to AML/SAR training, via updating AML/SAR e-learning modules, giving presentations and producing training materials.

• Analyse AML Investigations and SAR reports to propose control improvements and identify emerging AML trends.

• Maintain the AML/SAR team standard operating procedure (SOP).

• Organise and participate in the group monthly Money Laundering Reporting Officers (MLRO) feedback call.

• Maintain expert knowledge of AML/SAR law and regulation and financial crime trends with regard to money laundering.

• Work in close collaboration with the Group Sanctions team on cases with AML and sanctions overlap.

YOUR PROFILE:

• 3-6 years’ experience in AML Investigations in a Banking environment and a knowledge of suspicious activity reporting or similar Compliance function.

• A university degree in Law/Economics or comparable studies or equivalent in working experience in the financial industry sector.

• Strong analytical and IT skills (knowledge of the GoAML application desirable).

• Flexibility, adaptability with good intuition and problem solving skills.

• Good communication, networking and organisational skills.

• Ability to prioritise and work under pressure during fast-paced and demanding AML investigations.

• Team player with good communication skills with a high standard of written and spoken English

• Swiss domiciled (Geneva based).

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

International IT Services Specialist (80-100%)

International IT Services Specialists are responsible for the IT onsite support to Lombard Odier users across local offices. Their duties include installing, maintaining, and repairing hardware and software components of the organization’s computer systems. They provide support both remotely and through on-site visits, depending on the needs of the teams. The role involves frequent collaboration with Infrastructure Teams at the Headquarters, and depending on the context, may also take on project management responsibilities.

YOUR ROLE

• Provide support for Microsoft technologies: Windows 11, Office 365, Teams

• Manage Mobile Device Management for iOS and Android

• Assist in managing and maintaining network infrastructure under Level 3 supervision and perform 2nd-level troubleshooting

• Maintain and update the network and system CMDB (NetBox)

• Manage and maintain systems infrastructure in collaboration with the Systems Team (ESX)

• Manage and maintain the printing infrastructure

• Install and configure laptops, desktops, servers, switches, and perform patching work

• Troubleshoot and replace laptops, desktops, and components

• Support Citrix environments (XenApp, XenDesktop)

• Maintain and update software and hardware inventory

• Assist in budget preparation, manage contracts, and negotiate with local vendors

• Oversee contractor installations and maintenance during office moves, shutdown and opening operations

• Advise users on hardware and software usage

• Provide support to the bank’s Independent Asset Managers in the region

• Create, update, and maintain documentation and internal wiki

• Participate in implementation and deployment of group projects

• Contribute to the Business Continuity Plan and act as a point of contact during BCP invocation

YOUR PROFILE

• Degree in Computer Science, engineering or relevant field mandatory

• +7-years proven experience in IT technical support and similar roles

• Excellent command in installing, maintaining and troubleshooting computers running Windows 11

• Excellent command of Office 365, Teams

• Excellent command of Apple and Android mobile devices

• Strong knowledge of the OSI model and Enterprise Network Infrastructure

• Knowledge in Project Management of IT Infrastructure Projects

• Relevant certification from advantage (MS-700, CCNA, ITIL…)

• Willingness to continuously learn and high interest in new technologies

• High readiness to get things done

• Very good organization skills and ability to work independently and to be a great team player

• Strong service orientation and excellent communication skills

• Fluent in French and English

• Flexible to travel to the offices in the EMEA Region (Travel Activity 20%)

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Exc

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Per rafforzare ulteriormente il nostro dipartimento di beni privati, stiamo cercando una base di Ginevra Private Assets Investment Controller (80-100%) In questo ruolo, contribuirai alla supervisione operativa, finanziaria e analitica dei nostri portafogli Private Assets. Il tuo!
• Assicurare il follow-up amministrativo dei fondi e dei mandati di investimento dei beni privati
• Raccogliere, verificare e elaborare moduli di abbonamento per nuovi investimenti
• Preparare e rilasciare comunicazioni di capitale e distribuzione
• Sostenere la preparazione di report AUM e NNM
• Partecipare alla produzione di track record e analisi delle prestazioni
• Preparare le valutazioni trimestrali dei fondi di investimento dei beni privati
• Lanci del prodotto di supporto da una prospettiva operativa
• Partecipare alla preparazione e all'emissione di fatture client
• Contribuire ai miglioramenti del sistema IT tramite test di accettazione dell'utente e validazione
• Coordinare con gli Accountants del Fondo per garantire la conservazione accurata e l'integrità dei dati
• Preparare report e dashboard regolari per i gestori privati degli investimenti
• Sostenere la preparazione degli aggiornamenti per la gestione senior e le schede
• Eseguire attività di contabilità e di controllo per i prodotti e i mandati di Private Assets
• Sostenere le richieste di audit interno ed esterno e fornire assistenza attiva al team
• Liaise con i dipartimenti di tutto il Gruppo, LOIM e la Banca Privata (ad esempio, Finanza, Operazioni) Il tuo progetto
• Laurea magistrale, idealmente in economia, finanza o disciplina correlata
• 3-5 anni di esperienza nel controllo dei beni privati
• Forte comando dell'inglese (spoken e scritto) e buona conoscenza del francese
• Eccellente abilità di Excel; solida conoscenza di eFront; l'esposizione ad Alteryx o Tableau è un plus
• Rigoroso, orientato ai dettagli e in grado di gestire le priorità e rispettare le scadenze
• Forte giocatore di squadra con una mentalità collaborativa e eccellenti capacità di comunicazione Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nella massima fiducia.
descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

To further strengthen our Private Assets department, we are looking for a Geneva based

Private Assets Investment Controller (80-100%)

In this role, you will contribute to the operational, financial, and analytical oversight of our Private Assets portfolios.

YOUR ROLE

• Ensure the administrative follow-up of Private Assets investment funds and mandates

• Collect, verify, and process subscription forms for new investments

• Prepare and release capital call and distribution notices

• Support the preparation of AUM and NNM reporting

• Participate in the production of track records and performance analytics

• Prepare the quarterly valuations of Private Assets investment funds

• Support product launches from an operational perspectives

• Participate in the preparation and issuance of client invoices

• Contribute to IT system enhancements through user acceptance testing and validation

• Coordinate with Fund Accountants to ensure accurate bookkeeping and data integrity

• Prepare regular reports and dashboards for Private Assets Investment Managers

• Support the preparation of updates for Senior Management and Boards

• Perform accounting and controlling activities for Private Assets products and mandates

• Support internal and external audit requests and provide active assistance to the team

• Liaise with departments across the Group, LOIM, and the Private Bank (e.g., Finance, Operations)

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree, ideally in economics, finance, or a related discipline

• 3–5 years of experience in controlling within Private Assets

• Strong command of English (spoken and written) and good knowledge of French

• Excellent Excel skills; solid knowledge of eFront; exposure to Alteryx or Tableau is a plus

• Rigorous, detail‑oriented, and able to manage priorities and meet deadlines

• Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and excellent communication skills

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Um unsere Private Assets-Abteilung weiter zu stärken, suchen wir nach einem Genfer Unternehmen Private Assets Investment Controller (80-100%) In dieser Funktion tragen Sie zur operativen, finanziellen und analytischen Aufsicht unserer Private Assets Portfolios bei. IHRE ROLLE
• Gewährleistung der administrativen Nachverfolgung von Private Assets Investmentfonds und Mandaten
• Formulare für neue Investitionen sammeln, überprüfen und bearbeiten
• Vorbereiten und Freigeben von Kapitalanrufen und Verteilungsankündigungen
• Unterstützung der Vorbereitung der AUM- und NNM-Berichterstattung
• Teilnahme an der Produktion von Track Records und Performance Analytics
• Vorbereiten der vierteljährlichen Bewertungen von Private Assets Investmentfonds
• Produktstarts aus operativer Perspektive unterstützen
• Teilnahme an der Vorbereitung und Ausgabe von Kundenrechnungen
• Nutzen Sie IT-Systemerweiterungen durch Anwenderakzeptanzprüfung und Validierung
• Koordinieren Sie mit den Buchhaltern des Fonds, um eine genaue Buchführung und Datenintegrität sicherzustellen
• Erstellung regelmäßiger Berichte und Dashboards für Private Assets Investment Manager
• Unterstützung der Vorbereitung von Updates für Senior Management und Boards
• Durchführung von Rechnungslegungs- und Kontrolltätigkeiten für Private Assets Produkte und Mandate
• Unterstützung interner und externer Auditanfragen und Unterstützung für das Team
• Liaise mit Abteilungen im gesamten Konzern, LOIM und der Privatbank (z.B. Finanzen, Operationen) IHRE PROFILE
• Masterstudium, ideal in Wirtschaft, Finanzen oder einer verwandten Disziplin
• 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling innerhalb Private Assets
• Starker Befehl von Englisch (gesprochen und geschrieben) und gute Kenntnisse von Französisch
• Ausgezeichnete Excel-Fähigkeiten; solide Kenntnisse von eFront; Exposition gegenüber Alteryx oder Tableau ist ein Plus
• Robust, detailorientiert und in der Lage, Prioritäten zu verwalten und Termine zu erfüllen
• Starker Teamplayer mit einem kollaborativen Mindset und exzellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns dazu, das Beste zu sein, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt vorantreibt. Respekt unterstützt jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unsere Handlungen. Gemeinsam sind wir ein Team, vereint in der Betreuung unserer Kunden mit unerschütterlicher Hingabe. Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter und Kandidaten. Diversity, Equity und Inclusion sind in den Stoff unserer Maison’s DNA gewebt, und wir bemühen uns, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter ihre persönlichen und beruflichen Bestrebungen erfüllen können, indem wir interne Mobilität und individuelle Upskilling-Programme fördern. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass der Aufbau von Diverse Teams zu unseren Erfolgen beiträgt und dass wir darauf aktiv Diversity, Equity und Inclusion in unsere Geschäftsstrategie einbetten. Es ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich unseren Teams anzuschließen. Alle Anwendungen werden im strengsten Vertrauen behandelt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Pour renforcer davantage notre département des biens privés, nous recherchons une Contrôleur des investissements privés (80-100%) Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à la surveillance opérationnelle, financière et analytique de nos portefeuilles d'actifs privés. Votre rôle
• Assurer le suivi administratif des fonds et mandats d'investissement privés
• Recueillir, vérifier et traiter les formulaires de souscription pour les nouveaux investissements
• Préparer et publier les avis d'appel et de distribution
• Appuyer la préparation de rapports sur l'AUM et la NNM
• Participer à la production d'enregistrements de piste et d'analyses de performance
• Préparer les évaluations trimestrielles des fonds d'investissement privés
• Soutenir les lancements de produits sous l'angle opérationnel
• Participer à la préparation et à la publication des factures des clients;
• Contribuer à l'amélioration des systèmes informatiques par des tests d'acceptation et de validation des utilisateurs
• Coordonner avec les experts-comptables pour assurer l'exactitude de la comptabilité et de l'intégrité des données
• Préparer régulièrement des rapports et des tableaux de bord à l'intention des gestionnaires d'investissements privés
• Appuyer la préparation de mises à jour pour les cadres supérieurs et les conseils d'administration
• Exécuter des activités de comptabilité et de contrôle pour les produits et les mandats d'actifs privés
• Appuyer les demandes d'audit interne et externe et fournir une assistance active à l'équipe
• Assurer la liaison avec les départements du Groupe, de la LOIM et de la Banque privée (par exemple, Finances, Opérations) VOTRE PROFIL
• Maîtrise, idéalement en économie, finance ou discipline connexe
• 3-5 ans d'expérience dans le contrôle des actifs privés
• Forte maîtrise de l'anglais (parlé et écrit) et bonne connaissance du français
• Excellentes compétences Excel; solide connaissance de eFront; exposition à Alteryx ou Tableau est un plus
• Régulière, détaillée et capable de gérer les priorités et de respecter les délais
• Joueur d'équipe solide avec un esprit de collaboration et d'excellentes compétences en communication L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos succès et pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans notre stratégie d'affaires. C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre nos équipes. Toutes les demandes seront traitées avec la plus grande confiance.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of processes, controls and accounting monitoring tools

• CFC commercial employee, ideally complemented by experience in the banking, financial, accounting or fiduciary sector
• Additional training in accounting, finance or management, an asset

• Good knowledge of accounting, ideally applied to securities portfolios
• Knowledge of Swiss GAAP RPC standards, in particular RPC 26, as well as IFRS and/or standards GAAP, an asset

We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. With more than 200 professionals, our Investment Solutions department is responsible for providing sophisticated and customised investment proposals to our private clients. In this context, we are seeking an experienced Investment Advisor to join our wealth management team in Geneva. YOUR ROLE
• Actively manage, monitor and review advisory portfolios for South Europe and Latin America regions.
• Offer clients and bankers portfolio advisory services, in accordance to Lombard Odier’s view as well as clients’ constraints and preferences.
• Prepare and present in a compelling manner investment proposals, reports and presentations to clients and prospects.
• Contribute to the development of the investment offering and the client book through strong commercial support to bankers.
• Master the investment solutions offering of the bank, in order to advise the bankers and clients in the most adapted manner.
• Maintain a high degree of knowledge on financial markets, traditional and alternative assets, investment strategy and portfolio management as well as market trends, particularly in the regions of coverage.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. YOUR PROFILE
• Bank or university education and/or recognised diploma in investment (CFA an asset).
• Minimum 10 years’ proven track record in advisory and/or portfolio management, ideally in the regions of coverage.
• Excellent customer presentation, client service and communication skills. Strong commercial awareness.
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills, flexibility and autonomy, ability to acquire and share skills.
• Team player, with ability to acquire and share skills, build trust and collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients.
• Open and dynamic personality with ability to take decisions, flexibility and autonomy.
• Ability to work efficiently under pressure and evolving market conditions.
• Good knowledge of Bloomberg, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Fluent in English and French. Spanish would be an asset.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinnovato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati del mondo, che gestisce vicino a CHF 300 trilioni e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 225 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. "Rethink Everything" è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Sviluppatore completo IA/ML & Reporting Designer Partecipa al dipartimento Tecnologia e Operazioni di Lombard Odier nel team Content and Communications, responsabile della piattaforma di gestione dei contenuti e della produzione/distribuzione dei documenti cliente e partner. Siamo alla ricerca di uno sviluppatore IA/ML e Reporting Designer Full-Stack per contribuire a sviluppare la nostra nuova piattaforma di tecnologia bancaria, che è disponibile anche ad altre banche private svizzere ed europee. Integrato nei team di prodotto, si porterà competenze all'intersezione di LLM e ingegneria del software applicata alla finanza: una maggiore ricerca documentaria (RAG), l'orchestrazione e l'ottimizzazione dell'inferenza (on-prem/cloud), l'integrazione dei modelli nei viaggi di front-office e l'automazione del reporting in produzione. L'industrializzazione e la personalizzazione dei documenti attraverso la suite Quadient Inspire (templati, componenti, flussi di lavoro e pubblicazione), garantendo qualità, tracciabilità e verificabilità end-to-end. Si evolverà all'interno di un'organizzazione agile, vicino agli utenti finali e la professione, con il contatto di tecnologie moderne e provate. LA TUA MISSIONE
• Contribuire allo sviluppo delle nostre applicazioni di gestione dei contenuti e alla produzione/distribuzione di documenti.
• Comprendere le esigenze degli utenti, i problemi da risolvere e i vincoli tecnici.
• Proporre e realizzare soluzioni tecnologiche adeguate tenendo conto degli aspetti sopra menzionati. Il tuo progetto
• Master in informatica con specializzazione in AI, Machine Learning e analisi dei dati seguiti in una delle università politecniche svizzere.
• Prima esperienza professionale o stage significativi nello sviluppo delle applicazioni, nel reporting o negli strumenti documentari.
• Computer Vision: Mastery of LLM/VLM applicata ai documenti (RAG, estrazione visiva, comprensione del layout della pagina).
• Esperienza nel rilevamento di anomalie documentarie (controlli visivi, consistenza semantica, regole aziendali).
• Controllo dei linguaggi di programmazione Java e Python
• Esperienza di ingegneria LLM: fine tuning, quantizzazione, RAG (LangChain/LangGraph), e orchestrazione (LlamaIndex).
• Conoscenza del quadro di sviluppo delle applicazioni web angolari
• Esperienza di contenitore (Dockers / Kubernetes) e DevOps
• Esperienza pratica di metodologie Agile, Scrum è un plus
• Conoscenza attuale della lingua francese e inglese
• Hai una comunicazione eccellente sia per iscritto che per orale
• Hai una buona mente per l'analisi e una buona capacità di astrazione per identificare e spiegare il problema da risolvere prima di pensare a soluzioni
• Siete in grado di dare feedback costruttivi e pronti a riceverlo
• Hai una grande autonomia

descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renewed global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investment. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalized banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 trillion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 225 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. "Rethink Everything" is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our customers. Full-stack developer IA/ML & Reporting Designer Join Lombard Odier's Technology & Operations department in the Content and Communications team, responsible for the content management platform and the production/distribution of customer and partner documents. We are looking for a Full-Stack IA/ML and Reporting Designer developer to help develop our new banking technology platform, which is also available to other Swiss and European private banks. Integrated into the product teams, you will bring expertise to the intersection of LLM and software engineering applied to finance: enhanced documentary research (RAG), orchestration and optimization of inference (on-prem/cloud), integration of models into front-office journeys, and automation of reporting in production. You will industrialize the generation and customization of documents via the Quadient Inspire suite (templates, components, workflows and publication), guaranteeing quality, traceability and end-to-end auditability. You will evolve within an agile organisation, close to end users and the profession, with the contact of modern and proven technologies. YOUR MISSION
• Contribute to the development of our content management applications and document production/distribution.
• Understand user needs, problems to be solved and technical constraints.
• Propose and implement appropriate technological solutions taking into account the above-mentioned aspects. YOUR PROFILE
• Master in computer science with specialization in AI, Machine Learning and Data analytics followed at one of the Swiss polytechnic universities.
• First professional experience or significant internship in application development, reporting or documentary tools.
• Computer Vision: Mastery of LLM/VLM applied to documents (RAG, visual extraction, page layout comprehension).
• Experience in the detection of documentary anomalies (visual checks, semantic consistency, business rules).
• Controlling Java and Python programming languages
• LLM engineering experience: fine tuning, quantization, RAG (LangChain/LangGraph), and orchestration (LlamaIndex).
• Knowledge of Angular web application development framework
• Container experience (Dockers / Kubernetes) and DevOps
• Practical experience of methodologies Agile, Scrum is a plus
• Current knowledge of French and English
• You have an excellent communication in both writing and oral
• You have a good mind for analysis and a good capacity for abstraction in order to identify and explain the problem to be solved before thinking about solutions
• You are able to give constructive feedback and ready to receive it
• You have a great autonomy
• Home in Switzerland or willing to settle in Switzerland Our House

An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Internship – Private Banking – 6 months (External Asset Manager team – Luxembourg) The main goal of the position is to support our EAM clients in Europe acting as one of the first points of contact and maintaining strong trusted relationships with all clients throughout the entire life cycle of their business relationship with Lombard Odier, which includes daily and periodic activity. Activities include account opening, periodic compliance reviews, support for client queries, execution services, payment processing and the administration of the relationship to comply with Lombard Odier policies and procedures. YOUR ROLE:
• Support the EAM desk, the RMs, the Business Developer and the Team Head on their day-to-day
• Payments: Ensure that all payments are made in a timely manner.
• Ensure that Callbacks are executed in line with our internal procedure and duly recorded in a contact report
• Manage to keep a low level of Loss (Quality risk report)
• Respect and comply with Group & LOESA directives, Guideline on relationship with EAM and Compliance and risks framework.
• Follow and complete administrative tasks and initiatives launched by the Bank and/or by the Region (documentation gaps/deficiencies, EAM Annual reviews, etc...)
• Reduce significantly by at least 30% the number of pending Doc Priority 1 and 2 and ensure a very low level of new ones
• Ensure that at least for 80% of the new account opened, client have signed myLO access forms in order to increase the penetration rate and to reduce administrative and payment workload.
• Salesforce (CRM of EAM): Ensure the data quality is up to date
• Ensure that EAM central file is in line with our actual standards and up to date (Agreements, Fee Brochure, W8BenE etc.)
• Credit Cards: Take care of all credit card issues and responsibilities.
• Accounts: Ensure a smooth account closure process
• Oversee the scanning and accurate storage of documents within the database.
• E-mails: Ensure that all e-mails receive a timely response. YOUR PROFILE:
• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field
• Strong interest in wealth management, financial markets, and private banking activities
• Good understanding of economic and financial concepts, with the ability to support market order execution and administrative processes
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage administrative tasks efficiently

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per una crescente ricchezza globale e asset manager, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo quindi servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Account and Relationship Manager - Global Custody e Private Label Fund Clienti (80-100%) Come parte di un team piccolo, dinamico e orientato al cliente, siete responsabili del supporto completo di clienti istituzionali strategicamente importanti nella Svizzera tedesca. Descrizione del lavoro:
• Supporto completo per clienti Global Custody e Private Label Fund (inclusi Trouble Shooting) nelle seguenti aree: Servizi bancari del deposito, Contabilità del fondo, Attività agente di trasferimento, Servizi di infrastruttura bancaria, Outsourcing del processo di affari ecc.
• Interfaccia tra i clienti e varie agenzie interne a Zurigo, Ginevra e Lussemburgo (Fondsleitung, Fondsbuchhaltung, Wertschriften Legal-Operations.
• Gestione di vari progetti di clienti e lavori di analisti aziendali (ad esempio lancio di fondi di investimento, offerta per nuovi prodotti, recensioni di servizi, implementazione tecnica dei requisiti normativi, analisi delle esigenze del cliente, ecc.). Sostegno finanziario e prenotazione di transazioni di valori non dichiarati come private equity, infrastrutture, immobili ecc. Esperienza a contatto con gli asset manager esterni e/o Global Custody / clienti di fondo di vantaggio.
• Interessi nel settore dei fondi, nei processi operativi (processi) e nei problemi di investimento, combinati con la gioia dei numeri e il contatto regolare con gli enti interni ed esterni
• Ottima conoscenza degli utenti di MS Office
• Consapevolezza del cliente e della necessità, consapevolezza di alta qualità, lavoro accurato e indipendente
• Personalità attiva, impegnata e comunicativa con soz elevato
descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a growing global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We therefore offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Account and Relationship Manager - Global Custody and Private Label Funds Customers (80-100%) As part of a small, dynamic and customer-oriented team, you are responsible for the comprehensive support of strategically important institutional customers in German Switzerland. Job description:
• Comprehensive support for Global Custody and Private Label Funds customers (including Trouble Shooting) in the following areas: Depot Bank Services, Fund Accounting, Transfer Agent Activities, Bank Infrastructure Services, Business Process Outsourcing etc.
• Interface between customers and various internal agencies in Zurich, Geneva and Luxembourg (Fondsleitung, Fondsbuchhaltung, Wertschriften-Operations, IT, Legal, Tax etc.) and third parties (advisors, supervisors, consultants, etc.)
• Independent management of versatile customer projects and business analyst works (e.g. launching investment funds, offering new products, service reviews, technical implementation of regulatory requirements, analysis of customer needs etc.).
• Self-employed pre- and post-processing of customer meetings (learning committee, operational meetings etc.) and management / participation of meetings
• Set up and maintain contracts and SLAs with customers
• Creation of customer and fee bills and execution of fee checks
• Opening and maintenance of customer and account relations (sic production of correct documentation, updating account documents and contracts according to internal guidelines, etc.)
• Support in the execution of various operational activities such as cash management, payment transactions, billing and monitoring internally and externally traded FX and options and futures transactions. Coordination and booking of transactions of non-deposited values such as private equity, infrastructure, real estate etc.
• Using the creation and quality control of monthly and quarterly customer-specific investment reports (e.g. fund factsheets) for traditional and alternative investments Requirements profile:
• Banking with professionalism and completed further training (bank economyr HF, CFA /AZEK) or university degree
• At least five years of professional experience in the financial sector, ideally in the support of institutional customers
• Wide expertise in asset servicing (e.g. in the field of securities, stock exchange, back-and- middle office, investment consulting). Experience in contact with external asset managers and/or Global Custody / fund customers of advantage.
• Interest in fund business, in operational processes (processes) and investment topics, combined with joy in numbers and regular contact with internal and external bodies
• Very good MS Office user knowledge
• customer and need-oriented, high quality awareness, accurate and independent working
• Team-ready, dedicated and communicative personality with high soz
descriptionByLocale.de:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Account und Relationship Manager - Global Custody und Private Label Funds Kunden (80-100%) Als Teil eines kleinen, dynamischen und kundenorientierten Teams sind Sie verantwortlich für die umfassende Betreuung von strategisch wichtigen institutionellen Kunden in der Deutschschweiz. Stellenbeschreibung:
• Umfassende Betreuung der Global Custody- und Private Label Funds Kunden (inkl. Trouble Shooting) in folgenden Bereichen: Depotbankdienstleistungen, Fondsbuchhaltung, Transfer Agent Aktivitäten, Bankinfrastruktur-Dienstleistungen, Business Process Outsourcing usw.
• Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und diversen internen Stellen in Zürich, Genf und Luxembourg (Fondsleitung, Fondsbuchhaltung, Wertschriften-Operations, IT, Legal, Tax etc.) sowie Drittparteien (Vermögensverwalter, Revisoren, Consultants etc.)
• Eigenständige Führung von vielseitigen Kundenprojekten und Business Analyst Arbeiten (z.B. Lancierung von Anlagefonds, Offertstellung bei neuen Produkten, Service Reviews, technische Umsetzung von regulatorischen Anforderungen, Analyse von Kundenbedürfnissen etc.).
• Selbständige Vor- und Nachbearbeitung von Kundenmeetings (Lenkungsausschuss, operative Meetings etc.) und Führung / Teilnahme der Meetings
• Aufsetzen und Unterhalt von Verträgen und SLAs mit Kunden
• Erstellung von Kunden- und Gebührenabrechnungen und Ausführung von Gebührenchecks
• Eröffnung und Unterhalt der Kunden- und Kontenbeziehungen (Sicherstellung der korrekten Dokumentation, Aktualisierung der Kontodokumente und Verträge nach bankinternen Richtlinien etc.)
• Unterstützung bei der Ausführung von verschiedenen operativen Tätigkeiten wie Cash Management, Zahlungsverkehr, Abrechnung und Überwachung intern und extern gehandelter FX sowie Optionen- und Futures-Transaktionen. Koordination und Verbuchung von Transaktionen von nicht-deponierten Werten wie z.B. Private Equity, Infrastrukturanlagen, Immobilien etc.
• Mithilfe bei der Erstellung und Qualitätskontrolle von monatlichen und quartalsweisen kundenspezifischen Investmentreports (v.a. Fonds-Factsheets) für traditionelle und alternative Anlagen Anforderungsprofil:
• Banklehre mit Berufsmaturität und abgeschlossene Weiterbildung (Bankwirtschafter/in HF, CFA /AZEK) oder Hochschulabschluss
• Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Finanzsektor, idealerweise in der Betreuung von institutionellen Kunden
• Breite Fachkenntnisse im Bereich Asset Servicing (z. B. im Bereich Wertschriften, Börse, Back-& Middle-Office, Anlageberatung). Erfahrung im Kontakt mit externen Vermögensverwaltern und / oder Global Custody / Fonds-Kunden von Vorteil.
• Interesse am Fondsgeschäft, an operativen Abläufen (Prozessen) und Investmentthemen, verbunden mit Freude an Zahlen und regelmässigem Kontakt zu internen und externen Stellen
• Sehr gute MS Office Anwenderkenntnisse
• Kunden- und bedürfnisorientiert, hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein, genaue und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
• Teamfähige, engagierte und kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit hoher Soz
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gestionnaire mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs en croissance, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons donc des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous avons connu plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Gestionnaire de comptes et de relations - Clients des fonds de la Custodie mondiale et des fonds de la marque privée (80-100%) Dans le cadre d'une petite équipe dynamique et orientée vers le client, vous êtes responsable du soutien complet de clients institutionnels d'importance stratégique en Suisse allemande. Description du poste :
• Un soutien global aux clients des fonds de dépôt et des fonds de dépôt privés (y compris les opérations de tir) dans les domaines suivants : services bancaires de dépôt, comptabilité des fonds, activités des agents de transfert, services d'infrastructure bancaire, externalisation des processus d'affaires, etc.
• Interface entre les clients et diverses agences internes à Zurich, Genève et Luxembourg (Fondsleitung, Fondsbuchhaltung, Wertschriften-Operations, IT, Legal, Tax etc.) et des tiers (conseillers, superviseurs, consultants, etc.)
• Gestion indépendante des projets clients polyvalents et des travaux d'analystes d'entreprise (par exemple, lancement de fonds d'investissement, offre de nouveaux produits, revues de services, mise en œuvre technique des exigences réglementaires, analyse des besoins des clients, etc.).
• Pré-traitement et post-traitement des réunions des clients (comité d'apprentissage, réunions opérationnelles, etc.) et gestion/participation des réunions
• Établir et maintenir des contrats et des SLA avec les clients
• Création de factures de clients et de frais et exécution de contrôles de frais
• Ouverture et maintenance des relations client-compte (production de documents corrects, mise à jour des documents de compte et des contrats conformément aux directives internes, etc.)
• Appui à l'exécution de diverses activités opérationnelles telles que la gestion de la trésorerie, les opérations de paiement, la facturation et le suivi des opérations de change négociées à l'interne et à l'externe, ainsi que les options et les opérations à terme. Coordination et réservation des transactions portant sur des valeurs non déposées telles que les capitaux propres, les infrastructures, les biens immobiliers, etc.
• Utilisation de la création et du contrôle de la qualité de rapports mensuels et trimestriels sur les investissements spécifiques à la clientèle (par exemple fiches d'information sur les fonds) pour les investissements traditionnels et alternatifs Profil des exigences:
• Banque avec professionnalisme et formation continue complète (banque économique HF, CFA /AZEK) ou diplôme universitaire
• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience professionnelle dans le secteur financier, idéalement dans le soutien des clients institutionnels
• Une vaste expertise dans le service des actifs (par exemple dans le domaine des valeurs mobilières, de la bourse, de l'administration centrale, de la consultation en investissement). Expérience en contact avec des gestionnaires d'actifs externes et/ou des clients d'avantage Global Custody / fonds.
• Intérêt dans les activités de fonds, dans les processus opérationnels (processus) et les thèmes d'investissement, associé à la joie en nombre et aux contacts réguliers avec les organismes internes et externes
• Très bonne connaissance des utilisateurs de MS Office
• sensibilisation du client et des besoins, haute qualité, travail précis et indépendant
• Personnalité d'équipe, dédiée et communicative avec haute soz

Business Manager – Consegna della piattaforma e coinvolgimento dei clienti (80-100%) Lombard Odier fornisce la sua piattaforma proprietaria di private-banking ad un numero crescente di istituzioni esterne tramite un modello ITO/BPO. Banking Platform Services (BPS) funge da interfaccia centrale con queste banche partner, coordinando le operazioni di distribuzione della piattaforma, gestione dei cambiamenti e servizio. Per rafforzare il nostro modello operativo, stiamo cercando un Business Manager dedicato a migliorare i nostri processi, standardizzare le pratiche di customer-engagement e implementare gli strumenti che ci permettono di gestire in modo efficace la modifica della roadmap, dei casi di servizio e dei framework di governance. Il tuo!
• Definire, standardizzare e migliorare continuamente i processi in BPS (gestione dei cambiamenti, gestione dei casi, governance, reporting).
• Implementazione e manutenzione di strumenti di classe migliore per i flussi di lavoro di relazione client, tra cui roadmap supervisione, assunzione della domanda, casi di gestione del servizio, KPI e dashboard.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Client Platform Advisors e Relationship Manager per garantire un'esperienza client coerente e qualità di consegna in tutte le banche partner.
• Coordinare le iniziative interfunzionali con IT, Prodotto, Operazioni e Rischi per semplificare il modo in cui le richieste dei clienti vengono catturate, valutate e eseguite.
• Condurre progetti interni volti ad aumentare l'efficienza operativa, la trasparenza e la scalabilità.
• Guidare gli standard di documentazione e sostenere le pratiche di gestione della conoscenza interna.
• Monitorare l'evoluzione della piattaforma e garantire che tutti i processi orientati al cliente rimangano allineati con priorità strategiche. Il tuo progetto
• Laurea in economia, tecnologia, operazioni o un campo correlato.
• 5+ anni di esperienza nella consulenza, business- o project management nei servizi finanziari o nella tecnologia.
• Forte comprensione dei modelli operativi, ottimizzazione dei processi e implementazione degli utensili.
• Esperienza con soluzioni di gestione del servizio o di gestione del progetto (ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, PowerBI, ecc.).
• Ottimi capacità organizzative, analitiche e di comunicazione.
• Capacità di lavorare con più stakeholder e guidare il cambiamento tra le squadre.
• Fluency in francese e inglese.
• Residente in Svizzera o disponibilità a trasferirsi. Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Unsere Division Technology & Operations baut, betreibt und entwickelt diese Plattform kontinuierlich. Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, sich zu einer kundenorientierten Beratungsrolle zu entwickeln und gleichzeitig ein starkes Know-how in den Bereichen Private-Banking-Prozesse und -Technologie zu entwickeln. • Unterstützung von Senior Advisoren bei der Verwaltung von Tages-zu-Tage-Interaktionen mit Partnerbanken und deren Plattformbedarf zu verstehen.

• Um die Geschäftsanforderungen in klare Anforderungen an IT- und Operations-Teams umzusetzen.
• Hilfe bei Änderungsanfragen, Roadmap-Elementen und Plattformerweiterungen.
• Entwickeln Sie die Vertrautheit mit der proprietären Private-Banking-Plattform von LO und ihrer front-to-back-Architektur.
• Teilnahme an Workshops, Testaktivitäten und internen Koordinierungssitzungen.
• Über Plattformentwicklungen und Branchentrends in der Vermögensverwaltungstechnik informiert bleiben. IHRE PROFILE
• Hochschulabschluss in Wirtschaft, IT, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Bank-, Beratungs-, Unternehmensanalyse- oder Technologiebereich (inklusive Praktika).
